Friend - "Ranked choice" voting is a popular tool in the push to make the voting process more democratic and enable citizens to have a greater voice when they go to the polls.
If you’ve never heard of it, the explanation is simple : the voter gets to rank the candidates in the order they prefer them, instead of just picking one. This helps empower a diverse slate of candidates and also acknowledges that, if your first choice didn’t win, you’d certainly prefer a second candidate who more closely resembles your beliefs rather than having the other main party win by default.
The use of ranked choice voting is still being discussed, including states like Alaska, where an effort is underway to get rid of it.
With the debate continuing, we need to know how interested you are in fighting for the implementation of ranked-choice voting.
Do you approve of ranked choice voting?

Election Day is in 1 Week

|
---
On November 4th, voters will decide whether we elect climate leaders who will fight for a liveable future for all of us or politicians who will look the other way as corporate polluters continue to harm our communities and our planet. These down-ballot races are often decided by just a handful of votes. We can secure the future our communities deserve, but we need the right people in office to make that happen. Check out our slate of Pennsylvania climate champions and voter resources below, and make sure to cast your ballot by November 4. The government shutdown is now entering its second month — and every day it drags on, the impact on families here in New Mexico grows more devastating.
If Speaker Mike Johnson continues to refuse to reopen the House, **families could soon lose access to the food they rely on to get through the month**.
**Head Start programs may be forced to close their doors** , leaving children without early education, care, and health screenings.
And without premium assistance, **health care costs could skyrocket** — with some middle-income households seeing their premiums more than double next year.
**All of this hardship is completely avoidable**. But instead of coming back to the table and ending the shutdown, Speaker Johnson and House Republicans are choosing to play politics while families suffer.
**We can’t afford to sit back and watch.**
We set an $8,000 end-of-month fundraising deadline on Friday, and we’re counting on grassroots supporters like you to help us keep fighting for the programs New Mexico’s families depend on.

Dear Peter,
Oregon’s fish, wildlife, and wild places are in crisis. Despite this, during the 2025 Legislative Session, thanks to the use of a political stall tactic, 1% for Wildlife ( HB 2977 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2025R1/Measures/Overview/HB2977] ) never made it to the Senate floor for a vote after passing the House floor with strong bipartisan support. We came closer than ever to passing this historic bill this past session, and the job isn’t over yet. Will you show your support for Oregon’s wildlife, Peter? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7XgGkaXIBkaJQgy2GR5O-g2]
Take action for wildlife [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7XgGkaXIBkaJQgy2GR5O-g2?contactdata=1ctN7agNQOQsqv2qMeJF1EHqNOS0916KxaSmTvzQffmSGYF4vY0LP6LYrWA6Df6AnDdQliVTHS0Uup5NKncwBgXanXu4HL4O34VdVhEop+JoCG5vP76Us2BoWmJRHbOj]
You know how special Oregon, and the wildlife that call this place home, is. It defines our state and is closely tied to most Oregonians' values to see fish, wildlife and habitats not just survive, but thrive.
Unfortunately, many of these iconic, native species are in decline due to habitat loss, climate change, and development — pushing them even further towards extinction. Nearly 300 species are at risk of extinction.
1% for Wildlife ( HB 2977 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2025R1/Measures/Overview/HB2977] ) is a bold, proactive solution to directly help at-risk species and habitats. Currently, the Oregon Dept of Fish and Wildlife (ODFW) does not receive any dedicated funds from the state for the recovery and conservation of such species and habitats.
Increasing Oregon’s state transient lodging tax, currently the third lowest in the country, would provide a sustainable source of funds to ODFW to recover Oregon’s most imperiled species and habitat and enhance biodiversity — all of which contribute to Oregon’s tourism and outdoor recreation economy while keeping the tax at still one of the lowest in the country.
This bill wouldn’t have made it as far as it did in the legislature during the past session without your strong support, and we can't stop now. We need Governor Kotek’s support to have a real shot at passing this historic funding bill during the 2026 session, to put Oregon’s most vulnera ble wildlife on a better trajectory. Please send your email to Governor Kotek now! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7XgGkaXIBkaJQgy2GR5O-g2]
Take action for wildlife [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7XgGkaXIBkaJQgy2GR5O-g2?contactdata=1ctN7agNQOQsqv2qMeJF1EHqNOS0916KxaSmTvzQffmSGYF4vY0LP6LYrWA6Df6AnDdQliVTHS0Uup5NKncwBgXanXu4HL4O34VdVhEop+JoCG5vP76Us2BoWmJRHbOj]
Sincerely,

Eliza Walton (she/they)

Peter, are you sure this is where you stand?
Radical Democrats are millimeters away from getting what they've always wanted: making Washington D.C. the 51st state.
Let me be clear, this isn't about equality or representation--it's about control.

Our capital is NOT a state; it's time to stop the push for DC statehood.

name: Bob Brooks
subject: I’m running in one of the most competitive districts in the country
disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
I’m a firefighter, a dad, and someone who has spent his life working hard for myself, my family, and my community.
#
Peter, I’m Bob Brooks. I’m a firefighter, a dad, and someone who has spent his life working hard for myself, my family, and my community.
**I’m running to defeat Republican Ryan Mackenzie in PA-07. Last year, he won this race by just one percentage point. Next year, we have the chance to defeat him.**
**[I want to tell you a bit more about who I am and why I’m running for Congress, but if you’re already with me in the fight to flip this competitive seat, then I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between State Democrats Committee and me →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/97127?refcode=em20251028-9644&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9644%2E614464%2Ep4sP78)**
**[Donate →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/97127?refcode=em20251028-9644&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9644%2E614464%2Ep4sP78)**
From a young age, I worked plenty of different jobs. Paperboy, fry cook, dishwasher, bartender, pizza delivery driver — you name it, I did it. I know what it’s like to clock in early, work hard, and still wonder if you’re getting ahead.
**But in 2005, I found my passion: I became a firefighter with the city of Bethlehem.**
I spent 20 years there because fighting fires was more than just a job for me — it was about serving my community and standing up for the people who keep us safe.
Republicans in Congress like Ryan Mackenzie are spending their time prioritizing Donald Trump and the wealthy billionaires who back their campaigns.
While families in PA-07 struggle with rising costs and making ends meet, Mackenzie is busy supporting policies that slash Medicaid and SNAP to pay for tax cuts to the rich and powerful.
We deserve better. We deserve someone who understands what working class families and small business owners are going through. We need someone who knows what it means to work hard and still wonder if you’re going to get by.
I’m that person, Peter. I’m running so that I can fight for you, the people.

Bob

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Earlier this month, we asked you to share your candid thoughts and
feelings with us about the current state of the Democratic Party, Justice
Democrats’ 2026 candidates so far, and next year’s elections.

We received more than 1,300 survey submissions, and wanted to share a few
key takeaways:

* Most survey-takers said they are EXCITED about the 2026 Democratic
primary candidates that Justice Democrats has endorsed so far, with
many specifically highlighting our most recent campaign launch, Justin
J. Pearson in Tennessee’s 9th District.
* While most folks said they’re optimistic about the 2026 elections
especially with our new candidates challenging corporate incumbents,
many of you said you’re feeling pessimistic or expressed fear that
Trump, the Supreme Court, and MAGA Republicans will deny the results
or suppress voting rights so much that they undermine our voices and
win.
* When asked if you feel like the Democratic Party represents you, the
majority said, “No.” We can’t say we’re surprised, but it shouldn’t be
that way — that’s why we’re working so hard to transform the Party
from the ground up by electing more working-class, progressive leaders
to Congress.
* Half of respondents said the Democratic Party is doing a good job
fighting back against Trump, while the other half said the exact
opposite. Across the board, most of you said more must be done to stop
our country’s slide into authoritarianism.
* When asked which incumbents need to go, most of you said every
Republican, plus any Democrats who are still taking money from lobbies
like Oil and Gas, AIPAC, and Big Pharma, and putting corporate
interests before the needs of the people. We couldn’t agree more!

With the midterm elections just over one year from now, we can’t let
fascism and Democratic leaderships’ failures convince us to become
hopeless and complacent. We can transform this Party to build our own
response to the Trump administration with a new slate of working class
champions to clean up shop in the Democratic Party.

There is no stronger opposition party than one for and by the people.

That starts here and now, with grassroots contributions from people like
you. Every donation goes toward supporting those leaders and this movement
to reshape this Party to be one that is unafraid to take on Trump, Musk,
the GOP, the corporate Democratic establishment, AIPAC, Crypto, and every
other monied interest that stands in our way.

subject: Urgent: Help Can’t Wait. Stand with Our Troops Facing Hurricane Melissa During a Shutdown
body:
In times of crisis, your support is more important than ever.
[](https://www.uso.org)
[DONATE NOW](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/A-VKBbWj8jHk/YW1FQzU0Yi9LVWNSUlJyWTZPckRYNUZ4QlplRmt5S21kbjR2c0xPNzFoZmRuN3RGZGkzeHl2bUdPOXNYWmQ2djBLUklRaXZjNFFseE9TeHVYWHZGMUhuQUQrYStFTDA0c3RZZjJMMy9RR3c9S0/YVpsYjlabDhhM3U3b0RhQUhaL2JBOWtXZlpkZjQ5Y0lDOG9hNVE0UXRSSVBqTW9weXRMUnBBdDJyZnhvYitiTVFNNDkwcWg1UDBEMEVPczJxOFZXOE1obUlWSFJQQm5zS0)

USO Supporter,
Hurricane Melissa has intensified into a **category 5** storm and is projected to make landfall in Cuba late Tuesday night. This storm threatens not only civilian communities -- but also the men and women in uniform and their families who serve our nation.
At the USO, we are ready to offer support and care when any need arises for our service members and their families. This includes providing support as a result of the ongoing government shutdown, and now also addressing the needs of some due to Hurricane Melissa. **In Florida, our team welcomed more than 1,000 evacuated U.S. citizens from Naval Station Guantanamo Bay in Pensacola.** Our team members from Orlando, Tampa and Jacksonville are ready to provide them with the support they need. For our service members and those who support them, the combination of hurricane relief and shutdown impacts intensifies the strain.
**[Help us reach an emergency-response goal of $30,000 via email and text message by midnight to help ensure we're prepared to support all our service members, no matter what. Please, will you donate $58 or more now to support our heroes at this critical moment and into the future?*](https://links.e.uso.)**
[RUSH AN EMERGENCY DONATION](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/a9zxSP-qaqsx/YW1FQzU0Yi9LVWNSUlJyWTZPckRYNUZ4QlplRmt5S21kbjR2c0xPNzFoZmRuN3RGZGkzeHl2bUdPOXNYWmQ2djBLUklRaXZjNFFseE9TeHVYWHZGMUhuQUQrYStFTDA0c3RZZjJMMy9RR3c9S0/YVpsYjlabDhhM3U3b0RhQUhaL2JBOWtXZlpkZjQ5Y0lDOG9hNVE0UXRSSVBqTW9weXRMUnBBdDJyZnhvYitiTVFNNDkwcWg1UDBEMEVPczJxOFZXOE1obUlWSFJQQm5zS0)
---
**Our service members are ready to jump into action at any moment to serve Americans at home and abroad . . . even in times of uncertainty. They are a critical part of our country 's response to hurricanes, wildfires and other disasters, conducting lifesaving search and rescue missions and helping communities rebuild in the wake of emergencies like Hurricane Melissa. Even in the midst of a government shutdown. **
**Your support right now matters more than ever.** When you give today, your donation helps empower the USO to:
1\. Provide real-time relief and other critical programs like snack packs, toiletries, hygiene products and Wi-Fi.
[RUSH $29](https://links.e.uso.)
---
2\. Extend support to families and pets displaced by the storm, a mission that is already underway, including in Pensacola.
[RUSH $58](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/N-)
---
3\. Deploy Mobile USO units -- our "USO Centers on Wheels" -- from Orlando, Tampa and Jacksonville to the front lines of response at NAS Pensacola, ensuring critical support everywhere our military community is moved.
[RUSH $116](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/k3vwHb-)
---
Because of you, we can be ready the moment disaster strikes. Because of you, service members -- many leaving their own homes behind -- have a place to rest, refresh and connect with their loved ones. Your generosity helps ensure the USO is fully equipped to respond.
[RUSH ANOTHER AMOUNT NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
**In the words of a soldier we recently served: "As soon as I saw the USO, it brought light to my face. I already knew they were going to take care of us." **
Let's bring that same light and care to those now displaced due to Hurricane Melissa. Together, we stand with them.
Always For the People Who Serve,

Tabitha Glenn
VP, USO
**[P.S. Every minute counts. Please give today to ensure the USO is ready when and where we're needed most.](https://links.e.uso.)**
*Your contribution will be joined with the contributions of others and used where it is needed most to strengthen the well-being of the people serving in America's military and their families.

# How we can help our community when the administration cuts SNAP benefits on November 1
---
[|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=ff46c5485c&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |

Nearly 40,000 people depend on SNAP in Spartanburg County. The Trump administration refuses to use federal emergency funds to bridge the program, and Gov McMaster has called on ‘charities’ to do the heavy lifting in our state.
The food banks are receiving an enormous amount of calls from individuals looking for food assistance. Not surprisingly, we are also receiving an increase in calls from people who want to help by distributing food. However, Food Banks have a strong network of partners in place who can distribute food quickly. What they need are people who can collect food and/or funds. Donate to your local food bank, pantry, and soup kitchens.
Money is always great but if that’s not possible, donate food. Shelf stable food is best. Consider organizing a food collection within your businesses, schools, and neighborhoods. [You can find a list of local places to support here.](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=5746b48200&e=edbde6c9b1)

– Pop top cans are helpful when available

# [Here’s why the administration’s shutdown has put SNAP at risk](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=0fcd90a7e6&e=edbde6c9b1)
---
| |

In an unprecedented situation, millions of Americans could **lose access** to a crucial food assistance program in the coming weeks amid the federal government shutdown.The US Department of Agriculture has said it does not have the money to pay $8 billion in food stamp benefits for November amid the funding impasse on Capitol Hill that led the government to shut down on October 1. The agency argues it cannot tap into its roughly **$6 billion contingency fund** to cover next month’s benefits, though Democratic lawmakers and advocates claim the USDA should — or is even obligated to — use the money.Without help from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or SNAP, the formal name for food stamps, many recipients are going to have to decide whether to use their limited budgets to buy groceries, pay rent, fill prescriptions or turn on the heat, said Ed Bolen, director of state SNAP strategies for the left-leaning Center on Budget and Policy Priorities.[**Read More**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=820aec6961&e=edbde6c9b1)

| |
Last Thursday I joined Emerge SC for their Women of the Year Award ceremony to honor Adair Ford Boroughs, Courtney Waters, and Inez Tenenbaum. It was an inspiring evening that reminded me there is a path forward for all of us.
We had an amazing turnout for door knocking this past weekend followed by our annual PRIDE celebration in downtown Spartanburg. Don’t forget you can vote early this week through Halloween and election day is November 4.
Democracy is a participatory experience, join me at [kathrynforcouncil.com](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=ba81e5a04e&e=edbde6c9b1).

------------------------------------------------------------

The Patriot Pack — Smoke for the Bold and the Free

Stand tall and light up freedom with The Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company — a powerful lineup built for true American patriots. **
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Patriot Pack
A Bold Salute to Liberty
------------------------------------------------------------

Raise your colors high — the Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company is the ultimate tribute to freedom, made for those who stand proud. This isn’t just a cigar set; it’s a declaration, a statement, and a smoke-filled salute to the red, white, and blue.

** Included Inside the Patriot Pack
------------------------------------------------------------

**
“The Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case
------------------------------------------------------------

Carry your cigars in patriotic style. This rugged yet elegant case is crafted in premium printed leather with the pledge of allegiance, built to safeguard your Patriot Cigars while projecting staunch American pride. Designed for travel, with room for three cigars up to a 60-ring size and a secure closure, it’s more than storage—it’s armor for your freedom smoke.

** Old Glory Cigar Cutter
------------------------------------------------------------

No patriot’s toolkit is complete without a sharp edge. The Old Glory Cigar Cutter is a dual-blade instrument worthy of the name. It slices clean and precise, honoring the flag with every snip (and making sure your draw is perfect).
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Finest Blends Under the Flag
------------------------------------------------------------

** TNT
------------------------------------------------------------

Explosive in flavor and bold in character, TNT is a powerhouse medium to full blend that commands your attention. From first light to the last ember, it burns with authority.

** MOAB (Mother of All Bombs)
------------------------------------------------------------

MOAB delivers a full-bodied punch, a maduro cigar that lives up to its name. Deep, rich, and intense — this is not for the faint of heart but for the true patriot who demands maximum firepower in flavor.

** Sidewinder
------------------------------------------------------------

Sleek, swift, and sly — the Sidewinder rounds out the pack with a medium blend that strikes with finesse. Balanced, bold, and full of character, it’s the curveball every patriotic smoker needs.

The Patriot Pack doesn’t stop there, you’ll also get a Patriot-branded beverage koozie, coaster, sticker, and patch—because every smoke session deserves a touch of American pride.
------------------------------------------------------------

** Why the Patriot Pack Matters
------------------------------------------------------------

This is not merely a sampler or gift set. The Patriot Pack is your on-demand arsenal of American spirit and premium craftsmanship. It’s a perfect companion for travel, a striking gift for fellow flag-bearers, or your own daily reminder that freedom is worth celebrating — one premium puff at a time.

Light up The Patriot Pack. Puff with pride. And let the smoke carry your pledge to liberty.

** Uncompromising Quality, Made for Patriots
------------------------------------------------------------

At Patriot Cigar Company, every cigar is handcrafted in Estelí, Nicaragua, using premium-aged tobacco (aged a minimum of three years). Our blends were born from the desire to bring together the love of premium smokes and the love of our country, forging a brand built on passion and pride.

subject: When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I prayed my family would be safe... God answered.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
God Works.

[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MTAyOV9EVS1HVC4xMTAxMTdfdDE3Mzg3NTUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTEwMjlfRFUtR1QuMTEwMTE3X3QxNzM4NzU1LTI4OTkifQ/JiqxKpUlrPOJ8xPemtIO9A)God works in mysterious ways...
When I started my first business, I prayed it would be successful... **God answered.**
When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I prayed my family would be safe... **God answered.**
When I saw career politicians turn their backs on Americans to put their pet projects before the interest of the American people, I prayed for a better outcome...
I was surprised when **_God called on ME_** to run for office.
I'm Troy Downing. You might not recognize my name, but that's okay.
I'm a combat veteran. A God-fearing Christian. A husband & a proud dad.
**[I'm also the Republican running for re-election in Congress for Montana in the biggest race in the country.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MTAyOV9EVS1HVC4xMTAxMTdfdDE3Mzg3NTUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTEwMjlfRFUtR1QuMTEwMTE3X3QxNzM4NzU1LTI4OTkifQ/HAzqK920_5CuSitd2-7BWQ)**
I'm not in this to become a household name or for the title. I don't care about any of that.
I'm a simple man who enjoys a beer, likes to hunt and fish with my buddies & puts my family before anything else.
**__But I'm at my wits' end with two-faced politicians and DC bigwigs who say one thing to your face, only to turn around & stab hard-working folks like you & me in the back.__**
I'll always tell the truth. I'll always put America first. I'll always stand up for what's right.
The Radical Left will spread lies about me & throw me under the bus just to end my campaign before the midterms.
**[Peter, can you take a leap of faith on a simple combat vet like me to beat the Left & save our country?](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MTAyOV9EVS1HVC4xMTAxMTdfdDE3Mzg3NTUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTEwMjlfRFUtR1QuMTEwMTE3X3QxNzM4NzU1LTI4OTkifQ/cGsCWk1EFZ7wBJ0n4_1V2A)**[HELP A COMBAT VET
](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MTAyOV9EVS1HVC4xMTAxMTdfdDE3Mzg3NTUtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTEwMjlfRFUtR1QuMTEwMTE3X3QxNzM4NzU1LTI4OTkifQ/jRBq8w7bwvVzcsU2yYJ1uA)I know if we win this race, we can bring the entire Democrat Machine to its knees.
Thank you & God Bless,
Troy Downing (R-MT)| |

| | Friend,

It’s Kendall Qualls. Thanks to Tim Walz, illegal immigrants can vote in Minnesota elections.
It’s true.
In 2023, Tim Walz signed his so-called _“Driver’s Licenses for All”_ bill, giving government IDs to people who broke the law to come here. Now those same IDs can be used to cast ballots.
**So while you - a hardworking Minnesotan - follow the rules, Tim Walz is letting illegal immigrants cancel out your vote.**

---
[CHIP IN NOW - HELP ME PUT A STOP TO ILLEGALS VOTING](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zcm77kkrqh70d2elanm1ra8dlp7o06puo00ibt78_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctj64o32cph2bs)
| | This isn’t just about incompetence. It’s about Tim Walz pushing Minnesota farther and farther down the progressive, woke rabbit hole. Walz and his far-left allies are trying to rewrite the rules to keep themselves in power and cater to criminals – and they are sacrificing the integrity of our elections to do it.

subject: Chairwoman Keesling Concludes 92 County Tour
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE
body:
I am confident that we are prepared for the battles ahead, and I am so grateful to everyone who took the time to meet with me and share their perspective. No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-e-qktqty-hhlljjcji-h/) **For Immediate Release: **October 28, 2025**Contact:** Gage Hoekstra, Press Secretary, **_[ghoekstra@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop)_** Chairwoman Keesling Announces the Conclusion of Her 92 County Tour**Indianapolis, IN** - Since being sworn in as Chairwoman for the Indiana Republican Party in February, Chairwoman Keesling dedicated herself to visiting every county before the year was out. Having finished the undertaking two months early, the Chairwoman is eager to continue hearing from Hoosiers across the state. **" Since becoming your Chairwoman, I have had the privilege of visiting every one of our state's 92 Counties. It has been a whirlwind, and as honored as I am to be one of the few Hoosiers to make this journey in under a year, I have been even more honored by the outpouring of support, insight, and goodwill I've received.****When Governor Braun offered me the nomination, he asked that I be a Chairwoman for all Hoosier Republicans, to make sure our members know that this is the Indiana Republican Party, not just the Indianapolis Republican Party. That has been my mission since the year began, and that is why I made it a priority to meet with elected and grassroots leaders, volunteers, and supporters from every corner of our state.****Everywhere I went, I saw leadership, courage, and dedication, and I am proud to report that our county and local parties are stronger than ever. I am confident that we are prepared for the battles ahead, and I am so grateful to everyone who took the time to meet with me and share their perspective.****Our party is strongest when we are united and eager to listen to one another, so if I can ever be of service, please do not hesitate to reach out. "** ### [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qktqty-hhlljjcji-r/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qktqty-hhlljjcji-y/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qktqty-hhlljjcji-j/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qktqty-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qktqty-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qktqty-hhlljjcji-d/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W. | We're excited to invite you to the next installment of the 2025 Campaign and Candidate Virtual Bootcamp Series, hosted in partnership with the Republican National Committee (RNC).
This series of training sessions are designed to equip you with the tools, strategies, and confidence to run a successful campaign and win. These trainings are designed for candidates running for office, campaign staff and volunteers who are involved or want to be involved in campaigns at any level, or those just wanting to learn the basics of running a political campaign. The [Virtual Bootcamp series](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001U9YQ9ds4u8Z4EpNJG0ZtpI8CjDeozOZhPi8iieq8nQly48UGDLPC5HRF8OiMcT69xkvJRgG6WyRZY5-hy2QvalpiZENneRJzCvuPA35Hr3NgqwA6f3l0qP04anzH30sbBKfWsvBtGvHYX0Mv4D6Nh9u-qhCMZCYH6-15Y5rMivyrKbTW7CC8nlAtTAfFGFOSE-bY5fQw0tk=&c=_k-Y-UN4o51URBbv4xCz6obvwKhv_Lr-W5zThw8FF6zZXJ-FX30nqg==&ch=lHDK-R7vevz5I-KiLvTAFBclW9SIwlGmtJEzWQiFmvkWLkOMKWNGag==) will take place over four weeks. Each session will have its own registration link, so be sure to sign up for the ones you plan to attend:

## Melissa Hits Jamaica, Heads to Cuba
Hurricane Melissa [struck Jamaica Tuesday with 185 mph winds](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCnwQ4DF5WhoPgbu_nbLQ3CdbwTlAmwY3z7jZvNvsB2N7nJOfnOx326O4q0P_67DW1d0rTjUSLWinl6us2Rd-tnzuTdjimGE-uOxwQCei4FBzMFR_GcuibYBRFQNWilHqRWAFo3qw0oB2OENovGXjk1IzjXK4-32zzjIBuyV5oUYKQQnerb3qBYdD9oUIO5Gc86gYFqyu0z0V5XXOKZ3phbn7Ym2rXWV2HqH4ORwXgcR-vncimuP4PxOhmMvwq-YaRSHP_hcaqFl5rT_sBSeUafcsDAVyo15ZPB2GQbXgfFSGXQrBOPzVH8bq9_muxt4SsAAP__bpWCaA), marking the strongest hurricane landfall in the island’s recorded history and one of the most powerful storms ever in the Atlantic. The storm made landfall near New Hope, bringing landslides, widespread power outages, and catastrophic flooding—prompting warnings from meteorologists of "storm of the century" damage. At least seven deaths have been reported across the Caribbean so far. See the [storm live tracker here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCnMR2RWRs2FC7-hi5_eyXamCVszmBkO4ny9idOp3uBq0ea0Tcfl_FCEmS7_aeVXZnjuPErBy6F03inlcTT8khJPG0cw_TmsvFrBA1t3ega-nEiCe_RVpObmYFNxa7BrkEDgFgtznb-2nprmAB7e_XU4Nlgh2iRyQNW4o62RkPfaG1Ne2p71jO2HYLp-nPvldU8SYnpdI-ylYXn8I5PTicf1yq4pZQ9K_NPwaBgoP0AHJGCIciTFQy_gHrlIDlT_SOrSyL_KdutfuwTFc5VctP-khAkd6isvq0k4Xun_Omcp4OvAAAA___YFXmQ). Melissa is expected to cross Jamaica and hit southeastern Cuba overnight, with evacuations underway for more than 600,000 people. [See footage from Jamaica](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOgzAQheHTmC7IzBg7FC4irdJl2y3RgIfgyOAIJiBuv2KvsO170lf8P4_2QTHF-flNE3sZcjvzviYW4aV90USxp_GzLLGnmXMKB8vMewsa6kulL9C0gWI6WlMEPzADY8G-crZyCOBcMXpnTNDYUejImc5iBxyutnNormQDUhH9qVUamkprg3VZN6wHV1sHaJtr0yujOUTJS_nKcZaRh3TkjZeyz1OR_CjyXhXeFNwV3Pd9L4_8kU_H538uJP2o8L4p_MJ5O26X100ea7H48N5jSnG1Thn9nCimP1L-1WHz8BsAAP__E2dxBA). Red Cross officials estimate Melissa will affect at least 1.5 million people in Jamaica alone. Up to 40 inches of rain could fall in some areas, raising fears of deadly landslides. The storm remains a major hurricane and is forecast to hit the [southeastern Bahamas by Wednesday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd0TwDMYuKLZxl223tN7CIybCJgImlv9-lJlRfmDqI13dc_5dlyvGFPfbX9zItpCXnY6aqDUqyx03jA7Xj1Kiw51y8ie1nY4FBGguBYdp8RjTuajO20AE1HdkpRmk6QGM6VYrgzQjydFI_C-0JyV8ANdP0CstA6ou2teaFDBJIVSvL3oiEYweDPTDNE6OKUE-tlwu9xz3tlJIZ35Subi8dcmurT0q6_8wmBnMB2FbvxmDubZctspgfjswmF-GDOa3w8jflG-UYq3IHTa65XJyzX8q8JALOaytK9Y_jphSrINhStw2jOnrS_tVwKeFzwAAAP__oEaEdw) evening.

_**Editor’s Note:** This historic storm has left many Jamaicans in desperate need. If you’d like to help, The Flyover has partnered with Convoy of Hope to provide aid and assistance to the devastated island. The Flyover is pitching in as well, matching the first $2,000 in donations_** _._**__[_Please click here to donate_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb2u2zAMhZ9G3hzIlGJFg4eLBt7StaPBK9ExL_QTSEoCv33h4rYv0I04BD7yw_l1W27IgdP9J0aa2pqXRO8aqDUqyxdGZIfbsxR2mCgHv1NL9F5AwrkfZA928chhX3Tnp5UISHU0DWYcjAIwptsmrb0zK3hJerDWWnPxWmsv7YCfn3rAjqeDNkiwg5RanU9nS3I159GAGu3FOqEleW65nL4yp7bRGvb8onJyOXZh2lp7VKE-BMwCZpfTK-953fKDTrncBcw-J2x0DFyxNip9ocC0Cpj_qfWRAteK_fHLQVLzs8Wl5mdxJNT1-6SA8YgjeX5Goa4UkcN36DA-kO9JqOuPj1svpYGL_bvLqVFqQl0TNs4JQ59CVyb_eHMIXEcjtLwfsD9S7b-aeE3wOwAA__9vGZ4J).
## Israel Strikes Gaza After Hamas Attack
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered [“powerful strikes” across Gaza Tuesday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpTAQhE9jMj_5BzAEDjYhm003RC3cQM8YG9n9BrGnX7FXmKykKn2qqj8f8wdQpLT9hgM9r3lOeNWIzFjmTziAFtjfpdACCXMMN3LCazbKdFIracY5AMV7bpvgV0SDtkGvXa-dNca5ZvducGqxAwawHYLutMZe6dZpa_sugG3IPzStzKiVam336kZUq-t6Z2w_DuMiWoWBOJfXZ6bEO67xzt9YXks-muh35rMK-0uYSZgp3Weu_FjCTA9YmEmrRw_CTFcuMchn4hNFhnTD_pa5BCxV0nFgIGCUkII884VlfUdZudAXVklJbvAXJKyMRe5wQJUQI24Y4i2BGZYvDJLCKszUFB_Oi2Kk2jvRqu0Aiv8b849u_vbmXwAAAP__l_ORwQ) after Hamas gunmen opened fire on Israeli troops in the southern city of Rafah. The strikes came after Hamas turned over partial remains of Ofir Tzarfati, a hostage already [declared dead and buried twice](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuhDAQheHTmA5kj8HGhYs0dJs2JZrgYZmVwSvjrLW3j8gVUj_pk97_dZtvyJGP-yfu5Mua5oPqGakUyvMDd-QFt5-cecGDUgxvKgfVGSQMrZItuDkgx_fcN8GvREC6Ia-sUVYDWNtsfgzfvQUc9Lq4flXBmpEIUcpgrBwBGvaXpiQ4JWWvh25wJFc7GAvauNEtopcUuKTcPRIfZaM1vtOLcrekvYl-K-V5Cv0hYBIw1Vq7xzOd5VoFTHxmpNherwRMmAsvkdrRKqdNk314Vo6RT2NFL-87cvxTy79SvDz8BgAA__8SjnGI) before.

Drone footage later revealed Hamas militants had staged the burial and “discovery” of the remains just prior to the handover. Israeli officials condemned the act as psychological warfare and a blatant violation of the ceasefire agreement. [Egyptian teams with heavy machinery](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOnDAQRp_GdEa-cStcbBTRbZQoRUo04DF4ZWxkexeRp4_IK_ztHOlovvPnOT3BeRfWH7CjLjZOAc_ssRRM0wt2cAts75TcAgGjNxeWgOckmGgoZ1QMkwHnr0lVRltEgbJCzbuWd1KIrqs2bU0P2Cg7W86snC3vGwaNmo3tZ6UsVE7fNs7EwBlTsqmbAZntmrYTsh36YSGKoXElpvoVXSgbWn_FD6Z6iXvl9VbKkYl8EDESMZ7nWe853IyIEQN9ZyLGe9QNY_LmPq_XUSgEQxMauqSYM73dNCOkZaM2JrrFXGBFOkfjMFMX6Ap_gYgREn08-E8Uv55EjnFxhsjv3-6EeObfmI4qaXOcznuX244otu7g_P9ny5cKf7T4FwAA___uEpEL) are now working in Gaza to help locate the remains of hostages buried under rubble.
## Lost Dr. Seuss Book Found
A [never-before-seen Dr. Seuss book](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULuOpDAQ_BrIjEwb8BA4uIRsLr0Q-dEMPWdsZJtB_P2KzTbesLtK9fr3nJ-aPIXXX72hKkucA57ZYymY5rfeNFm9HimR1QGjdxeWgOcMHHrWcgbj7DT5a-5qpxZEQFGjauXQSgEgZb0q0ZlusdD30piHdmJ8LAKM41xyK0C4mtSt1nIYW8470Tf9iHyR_SBBDONjtFXH0VGJqXlHCmXFxV_xg6mxcau9WkvZcyX-VDBVMJ3n2QRj7xY3XsG0x53Zw5cj4c-L3aQKpiPsh_GUV3T3y1_MUba3AzrmEst45MxMjP-ZjRuFFwMOA0s2aOg4gKyTcvtJ3lMeZNXx16bJf6crv5r0o-ArAAD__4IEjDY) has been discovered in the archives of UC San Diego’s Geisel Library and will be published next summer by Random House Children’s Books. Titled _Sing the 50 United States!_ , the rhyming story features the Cat in the Hat helping readers learn all 50 states, complete with Seuss’s trademark wordplay and rhythm. The manuscript includes original notes and a cover sketch by Ted Geisel (better known as Dr. Seuss), with new illustrations by artist Tom Brannon in Seuss’s signature style. See the book [cover and original sketches here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb2OpDAQhJ8Gsh4Z8-MlILhksr30QuSfYvCeaSPbDOLtT-w9woatLn2fSvXnc_7UPnh-_dYbprLEmXHmgFKQ5i-9aW_1eqTkrWbE4C4UxjlLIXtqBMlxdtqHa-5qNy2ARFtjatTQqFZKpep16oSyFsp0rflodDOawTRdazoIwLoetZ9uWiPk2AjRtf2jHyEW1Q9KtsP4MdqqE3C-xPT4ip7LiiVc8Y30sHGrw7SWsueq_VXJZyWfrxCNDo8d_Do8J80ubms8Mu50JZ-aOR5ssYFLvm9inOEi57O9oXCk2RHjjUQGS0ygDDBtmo9sk98LmYtcoowjZyqRDGg_TPB5hbt__6X0bSW7-uASOJOJ8e9trNPk9tOH4POgqk68Nu3Dd5fyowHek_wXAAD__7VaoB8). To celebrate its launch, Dr. Seuss Enterprises and Random House are teaming up with the nonprofit First Book to deliver [copies and school supplies to classrooms nationwide](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAYAJ9GOwx8ImhBcY3dXnulYeFzZQ_BwOca3_6y9wp_PclMMn8ey8OGGNLrt93R0JqXhFeNSIRledvdBme3s5TgbMIc_Y2U8FqAw8AEZzAt3oZ4L7L1ZkUE7Fs0QiuhewCt282sSgo3DmqyXEgtRql7tMqO6qlHgYNsg_naBIdJcC77oRsm5KselIZeTePkGsnRB8qle-eQaMM13vmDpXN5b6PZiI7a9L8amBuYr-vqKHt7f2kD85EPd0Y6CzYw-8IqnrWyZ85_WQ3pxWhDNnB2pkDoWSVLWFlxyYLkIHhbjD-uEGOoSjeSv3Yb4v8w_ejWx8C_AAAA__8HQ324). Launching June 2, 2026, the book’s release will coincide with America’s 250th birthday.

The storm made landfall near New Hope, bringing landslides, widespread power outages, and catastrophic flooding—prompting warnings from meteorologists of "storm of the century" damage. At least seven deaths have been reported across the Caribbean so far. See the . Melissa is expected to cross Jamaica and hit southeastern Cuba overnight, with evacuations underway for more than 600,000 people. . Red Cross officials estimate Melissa will affect at least 1.5 million people in Jamaica alone. Up to 40 inches of rain could fall in some areas, raising fears of deadly landslides. The storm remains a major hurricane and is forecast to hit the evening. Editor’s Note: This historic storm has left many Jamaicans in desperate need. Israel Strikes Gaza After Hamas Attack Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered after Hamas gunmen opened fire on Israeli troops in the southern city of Rafah. The strikes came after Hamas turned over partial remains of Ofir Tzarfati, a hostage already before. Drone footage later revealed Hamas militants had staged the burial and “discovery” of the remains just prior to the handover. Israeli officials condemned the act as psychological warfare and a blatant violation of the ceasefire agreement. are now working in Gaza to help locate the remains of hostages buried under rubble. Lost Dr. Seuss Book Found A has been discovered in the archives of UC San Diego’s Geisel Library and will be published next summer by Random House Children’s Books. Titled Sing the 50 United States! , the rhyming story features the Cat in the Hat helping readers learn all 50 states, complete with Seuss’s trademark wordplay and rhythm. The manuscript includes original notes and a cover sketch by Ted Geisel (better known as Dr. Seuss), with new illustrations by artist Tom Brannon in Seuss’s signature style. See the book . To celebrate its launch, Dr. Seuss Enterprises and Random House are teaming up with the nonprofit First Book to deliver . Launching June 2, 2026, the book’s release will coincide with America’s 250th birthday. Attorney General Ken Paxton [sued the makers of Tylenol](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHSmzAMB_CnMZs5WWAMg4cu3tK1I-cYkfhicA4rIbx9j7Rv8E3SoPtLP_25jBcfU1xvv_1Clj9zHlfaSyJm2san_3Bey4sKH4nWnBb_oK3QOiKglgokDuPkYzrGtprsFaZBVWSV6ZRpdKfb6m793AU9BNOEAF3ozDzrlkJAamaNfQtVtGeYAhyUAtBY07VvggEKqE3TI4oWaIqct5rvxPTxZU5HftNWh7xUyd6Zn0U0vwQ6gW7f9_pVPOfJH-eAQFc4b4dAd8rO4jnmVaA79wp0Cs6-F-i-4fL0yv9g-U8sfUp0o0n6F8eyyBTXh0DXd0OLpm8AjEBXbXZ67jGlWDojWrgtPqbvjfyzz74t_g0AAP__3NOMXg) on Tuesday, accusing Johnson & Johnson and its subsidiary Kenvue of "deceptively marketing" the drug to pregnant women despite disputed research that its active ingredient can increase the risk of autism and ADHD in unborn children. name: MTG
subject: I’m being targeted by a disinformation campaign
body:
It’s so obvious.

| | | | |
---
Friend, I know when I’m being targeted.
I’ve been around DC long enough to recognize the signs. The attacks I am facing today are not organic. This isn’t random criticism.
**It’s strategic. And it’s heavily funded.**
They’re trying to flood the zone with lies. Smear campaigns. Bot attacks. Shadowy “news” stories that read like DNC press releases. It’s coming from all directions -**_and it’s coming fast._**
Who’s behind it?
Could be **deep-pocketed RINOs** who can’t take it when I don’t get on board with the corporate wing of my own party.
Could be **Democrat operatives** trying to soften the battlefield before the midterms or 2028.
Could even be **foreign actors** , hoping to fracture our movement from the inside out.
**Whoever it is - they’re spending real money to try and silence me.**
Why? Because I tell the truth. Because I don’t play the DC game. Because I won’t bow to lobbyists, corporate media, or the Swamp...
**I represent the people...****_Not_****the Washington, D.C. elites.**
**_[And because I stand with YOU - the America First patriots they despise](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bpAF/?__vbtrk=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**
I’m digging to get to the bottom of this. I will find out who’s pulling the strings.
But right now, I need something from you...
**[I need as many patriots as I can get - before midnight - to sign the "I STAND WITH MTG" letter and show the people organizing this disinformation campaign against me that it isn’t working >>>](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bpAF/?__vbtrk=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
[STAND WITH MTG](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bpAF/?__vbtrk=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I’m not asking because it’s convenient...**I’m asking because this moment matters.**
I need to know I’m not alone in this fight, and the people launching these attacks need to know it’s not going to work.
**_[If you’ve ever believed in the work I’m doing - exposing corruption, fighting for our values, standing up to the Uniparty - now is the time to show it](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bpAF/?__vbtrk=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI5ODQxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**
_In the Fight,_

Photo by [Adam Winger](https://substack.com/redirect/86d37401-9d54-4dba-a0b8-b637dc5f056d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://substack.com/redirect/f9872f22-828c-4975-af6a-2edb8a9385e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Too many Mississippians need a government permission slip to earn an honest living. Licensing boards--often staffed by the very people who profit from less competition--decide who may braid hair, fix a leaky pipe, or open shop. The result isn't "consumer protection." It's protectionism. Prices go up. Choices go down. And working-class families get squeezed into three bad options: pay more, do it themselves, or drift into the underground economy.
Mississippi licenses at least 118 occupations, touching nearly one-fifth of the workforce. Before a single dollar is earned, initial fees alone add up to more than $48 million, with another $13.5 million every year in renewals. Inside those gates, the nickel-and-diming continues; a commercial contractor can be out roughly $520 just to get started. If these hurdles consistently produced safer, better services, we could argue trade-offs. But they don't. Licensing all too often restricts both consumer and worker choice without reliably improving quality, while pushing low-income residents toward fewer, costlier options. That's not prosperity; that's a barrier.
There is some progress. The 2017 Occupational Board Compliance Act gave the Legislature tools to rein in excess. We also peeled back plainly needless rules--freeing hair braiders from cosmetology mandates and scrapping licensing for casket sellers after a court fight. Those were the right moves. They should be the template, not the exception.
Now do the job completely:
1. Publish the whole inventory--plain English, public, searchable. List every license, every requirement, every fee. Then benchmark against our neighbors. When we find outliers--niche licenses almost no one else requires--demand proof of a real, unmet health or safety risk. If that proof isn't there, cut the license. Not next year. Now.
2. Lock the front door on new licenses. Use a strict "sunrise" test: show evidence of actual harm, show why fraud/negligence law can't address it, and show a clear cost-benefit case. If it's duplicative or flimsy, the answer is no. The easiest mistake to fix is the one you never make.
3. Prefer voluntary certification over mandatory licensing. Let independent groups signal quality. Let consumers decide. Keep the courthouse open for cheaters and bad actors. We already use certification in several roles--expand that model instead of multiplying boards and fees.

The core principle is simple and old-fashioned: government should guard against force and fraud, not ration opportunity. We don't need committees deciding who can braid hair, sell a casket, or hang a shingle. We need clear rules against harm and open doors for anyone willing to work.
Mississippians understand this. Prosperity grows when free people serve willing customers--when the path into a trade is a straight line, not a maze of forms, fees, and insiders. If lawmakers want a fast, real win for ordinary people, start with transparency, sunrise reviews, and a wide turn toward voluntary certification. Tear down the moats and watch what Mississippians can build.

"You guys should totally do a community investment round for Noble Mobile."
This text came from Jonny Price, President of Wefunder and a good friend, a few weeks back.
I read it and thought, "Gosh, he's right." It wasn't appealing back when we were preparing for launch and trying to stay under wraps, but now it makes total sense.
I've always loved community rounds for a bunch of reasons:
1\. It makes investing more accessible to normal people.
2\. It gives a company a chance to reward and activate early adopters.
3\. It democratizes the kind of returns that an early-stage company can generate.
Community rounds have become more popular since the JOBS Act of 2012 which opened it up beyond accredited investors (i.e. rich people) to everyone.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ee71639b-e59c-4d1b-b861-75fa7463c19e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For Noble, we already planned to do something special for our first customers. And this way, we could get a group of people who were excited to promote the company on multiple levels; maybe they just love the idea of people being paid to log off and look up.
With investors like Scott Galloway and Corazon Capital, Noble already has a level of resources and institutional credibility. But there's nothing like a movement of people to kickstart widespread adoption and awareness. We all love to trumpet things that we have a stake in, whether it's emotional or financial.
And so, I'm pleased to announce our community round for Noble! We are holding a small allocation for people to invest with a thought of maybe doing more if there's a lot of enthusiasm. One can invest for as little as $100. Click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/f82c210d-825d-410e-9a24-27a8d4d6f845?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to check out the raise. As you can tell, it's less about the money and more about giving people a chance to participate.
For those of you who are new to [Noble](https://substack.com/redirect/a570211e-812f-4ac0-ac2d-f545787a6eaa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we charge $50 for unlimited monthly data but users get a $20 cashback bonus at the end of each month based on data use. So you literally get paid more if you doomscroll less, and we pay a 5.5% interest rate on your savings. We want to be your friend both saving you money and making it easier to look up and be present. I'm personally motivated by the fact that Americans are overpaying for our data by a factor of 2; I switched from Verizon and went from paying $140 a month to $48. For the average American household, that's a big deal.
We can save Americans billions of dollars on their data AND reward people for seeking experiences in the real world and not on a screen. Hope that sounds like a noble mission to be a part of.
To check out the Noble community round click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/f82c210d-825d-410e-9a24-27a8d4d6f845?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Offline](https://substack.com/redirect/04a286ab-3ca7-441b-99d3-c96a9eb6bc1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s no-phone party is coming to Brooklyn, Chicago, San Francisco and Los Angeles in November if you want to come out for a night and leave your cares at home.
Legalese: We are 'testing the waters' to gauge investor interest in an offering under Regulation Crowdfunding. No money or other consideration is being solicited. If sent, it will not be accepted. No offer to buy securities will be accepted. No part of the purchase price will be received until a Form C is filed and only through Wefunder's platform. Any indication of interest involves no obligation or commitment of any kind.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3a8ab412-31aa-4c73-b4c5-486138e64e9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

A few things that are true right now:
1. Cost of living is consistently [one of the most important issues for voters](https://substack.com/redirect/6bc1a09a-6cf8-4c67-bd1b-a8a3228a9d3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).1
2. Since last year, electricity bills [are up almost everywhere in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/12a50dab-adc8-41a3-8370-f182bf832e9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
3. AI is inescapably in the news, and Big Tech is [seen as Trump's strong ally](https://substack.com/redirect/b66bcc23-a84b-461f-8498-01c994a64b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).2
4. The [AI](https://substack.com/redirect/cf21fa03-1955-4a0a-9813-836885f3f164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [crypto](https://substack.com/redirect/100a1faa-0890-4ded-b163-b354435bdbf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) industries are driving up electricity costs because of how much power they're consuming, and their consumption [is only going to increase](https://substack.com/redirect/29abd370-a988-4e4b-882c-ba28eb4c2451?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
5. Americans see AI as a [culprit for rising energy costs](https://substack.com/redirect/31f4e690-09bb-418c-b132-b4a82856ce0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
6. The [One Big Beautiful Bill Act](https://substack.com/redirect/39177f62-9926-4636-a16a-6456b5a98aa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (OBBBA), the Republican-led law that passed earlier this year, [will lead to higher household electricity costs](https://substack.com/redirect/38b82544-a463-4fe8-bb04-5a470c2b5e02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).3

In short: we have an administration whose policies are driving up the cost of energy, and whose allies in AI and crypto are accelerating those increases even further.
All of that is an opportunity for Democrats--and a chance to reframe public opinion on clean energy investment.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTc3MTg0NjIxLCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzYxNzM5OTU0LCJleHAiOjIwNzczMTU5NTQsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.PMKqWis69Cs_J5yn0U6JF63R-aAwGMfKOxe8JehF7lY?)
> _**Article summary:**_
> * _Republican policies, both laws and tariffs, are driving up the cost of electricity._
> * _Another reason energy costs are going up: AI and crypto companies consume huge amounts of energy, just as Republicans are cozying up to both industries._
> * _Democrats should claim energy affordability as an issue --and reshape the narrative around renewable energy, since climate change alone has never been a political winner._
>

### Energy costs are up (almost) everywhere since last year
I noted [in my last article](https://substack.com/redirect/d8a7cd4c-4f58-4f87-85c4-7d7488d65c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that voters trust Republicans more than Democrats on pocketbook issues, which is a huge part of the reason that Trump was elected in '24.
So it's notable that in the last year, electricity prices are [increasing twice as fast as inflation](https://substack.com/redirect/aefa08bb-2706-4c4b-b87c-18ce09c9ea3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I'm all for Democrats throwing Biden under the bus, and I don't think he'll be remembered as a good president. He did things I would've done differently. But **the correct response to rising energy prices during the Biden years is not to disinvest in renewables** like nuclear, wind, and solar.
In any event, Biden isn't around to blame anymore, and public opinion has duly moved: [44% of Americans trust Democrats on energy issues](https://substack.com/redirect/15182b13-11d4-4804-9226-7cd336a842b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) vs. 43% who trust Republicans, a statistical tie.7

### Americans don't trust crypto and worry about AI
More on the details of Republican policies in a moment, but a significant driver of increased energy costs: AI and crypto companies, both of whom are fast becoming some of the Republican Party's most unwavering allies and donors.
Before we talk about the impact that AI and crypto companies have on energy consumption, it's worth noting that Americans are extremely skeptical of both industries.
[58% of Americans say](https://substack.com/redirect/31f4e690-09bb-418c-b132-b4a82856ce0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "AI could risk the future of humankind," which isn't exactly suggestive of an electorate that's excited to double down on artificial intelligence. Overwhelming majorities are concerned that AI will lead to chaos, job losses, and yes, higher energy costs.8
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31f4e690-09bb-418c-b132-b4a82856ce0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

There's similar intense skepticism around crypto: [only 5% of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/65110160-b3b9-42f7-8ad4-0dad53d4b6c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are extremely or very confident that cryptocurrencies are reliable and safe; 63% say that they're not.9
I bring this up as a way to say that Americans aren't inclined to trust companies in either industry. Both industries are very young, but when it comes to energy consumption, they're already huge market movers:
* Increases in energy prices are [higher in the places closest to data centers](https://substack.com/redirect/cf21fa03-1955-4a0a-9813-836885f3f164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Data centers and other commercial customers [are on track to consume more electricity than households by the end of 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/e3415964-b2f4-4251-84ae-34b9d5740ce5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),10 [an all-time first](https://substack.com/redirect/aefa08bb-2706-4c4b-b87c-18ce09c9ea3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). By 2028, data centers could consume [as much as 12% of the electricity in the U.S.](https://substack.com/redirect/0a6e2c35-a54a-424e-8d46-3be55d2bc232?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* In early 2024, [as much as 2.3% of U.S. electricity consumption](https://substack.com/redirect/0a016c20-9e20-4f78-baa0-9cc943d41bc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was going towards mining cryptocurrencies.11
* Over the next five years, [data centers will drive almost half](https://substack.com/redirect/29abd370-a988-4e4b-882c-ba28eb4c2451?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the country's growth in electricity demand.

[As I've said before](https://substack.com/redirect/efc4aa3c-6714-4642-870c-d61ef8f9a1be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I am not anti-AI, and I think the industry has enormous potential. But looking through this lens, AI is a fast-growing crisis.12
Data centers, AI, and crypto have booming needs for energy--and all of that is happening right at the same time that federal legislation is cutting energy production.
### The disastrous policies of [OBBBA](https://substack.com/redirect/387dfcf2-0d5d-4171-a3bd-73f1ee423b63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Republican tax bill
On top of changes to energy consumption and energy prices from crypto and AI, the other major change: Republican policies will almost certainly lead to higher electricity prices and higher utility bills.
I won't get into the weeds of everything, but in short: **by sunsetting a lot of federal support for investments in new sources of energy, we 're reducing the overall supply of energy, which will drive up the cost of electricity--especially with demand growing so substantially**.
The consensus is that electricity bills will go up because of the OBBBA, though by how much is a matter of debate. Estimates I've seen for increases to annual household energy costs range from [$78 on the low end](https://substack.com/redirect/e131a605-a743-49ee-b7b1-e61651e0b1cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [$540 on the high end](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa982e3-915f-44b5-b4d5-cc8b38b28f2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Either way, to state the obvious: this will not be popular.
And that's before we get to tariffs. Tariffs aren't part of the OBBBA legislation, because Trump unilaterally imposed them. But tariffs will have a huge impact on energy costs too, and that's not just for renewables. Below is an [analysis from Vinson & Elkins](https://substack.com/redirect/eb22fcfa-1abf-4dc5-b88a-17acff27ea9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of the country's leading [energy-focused law firms](https://substack.com/redirect/b1f7fc43-fdf4-4461-abf3-ad7a2f324dca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Democrats need to capitalize on this--especially given that [Americans already believe the OBBBA will have a negative impact](https://substack.com/redirect/3aa2ab29-aa93-4f44-85ee-7e95d6e17a1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the country.

### Reframing the renewable energy debate
The [climate crisis is becoming more acute](https://substack.com/redirect/65d8caf9-b089-44c9-88d6-d5f33c8011b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),13 but [climate was hardly mentioned in the '24 elections](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c3f84d-3dad-4837-aa5d-fe5c0f321d34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), after having been a marquee issue in 2020. That was responsive to how voters were feeling: the issue was less important to American voters [in 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/68ea4249-0380-46ad-9a6c-c4e8dc742179?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than it was [four years prior](https://substack.com/redirect/e5e2f95b-3076-4a2e-ba17-f1714d17acfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The [partisan divide on climate change](https://substack.com/redirect/fc68a48b-4353-4b84-a415-c8251cd19ab4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has grown, and Republicans have been effective in convincing voters that investments in renewable energy lead to higher energy costs.
But that's just not true. And Republicans are giving Democrats a chance to reframe the issue of investing in renewable energy as a question of affordability, not a question of addressing climate change.14
### "Drill, baby, drill" isn't lowering anyone's energy costs

* OBBBA isn't popular and will lead to higher electricity bills.15
* AI and crypto companies are driving up the cost of energy, right at the same time that executives across both industries are cozying up and/or kowtowing to the Trump administration. Both industries are immensely unpopular and distrusted.
* Young voters see [addressing climate change as a top-five priority](https://substack.com/redirect/aa84916c-0384-461c-a6b3-56681c877bc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and as _[the](https://substack.com/redirect/700caa12-e125-4a77-853e-8c1eda90d01d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ top foreign policy issue](https://substack.com/redirect/700caa12-e125-4a77-853e-8c1eda90d01d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). **We need to produce more energy; Republicans are against that.** Crypto and AI are consuming vast amounts of energy; Republicans are cozying up to their lobbyists and donors. Electricity bills are becoming unaffordable; Republican tariffs are making those bills more expensive than ever.
Republicans might blame Biden, but he's old and gone. The blame falls in the lap of a Republican government, something Democrats would do well to remind voters.

Please read my letter.
| **_A LETTER FROM THE DESK OF REP. JIM JORDAN_**
---
Peter,
---
Over the last month, Democrats have picked up two seats in special elections.
---
**Republicans are now just _ONE_ _SEAT_ over the threshold to declare a majority in the House. **
---
_That means we have almost NO ROOM for error anymore..._
---
_In the midterms, we need to not just DEFEND every single Republican seat, but we need to take the offensive to FLIP Democrat seats as well!_
---
Look – I’ll be honest with you: Our Republican House majority is the KEY to passing President Trump’s America First agenda.
---
If we lose it, the Democrats will be able to sabotage everything we’re trying to do, and they won’t stop there...
---
These radicals will attempt to IMPEACH President Trump and bring our country straight back to the days of the failed Biden-Harris agenda.
---
**Given how critical the House Majority is, I’m making you a solemn promise...**
---
I’m going to do EVERYTHING in my power to help Republicans DEFEND our razor-thin majority so we can continue Making America Great Again!

_...But I’m humble enough to know this isn’t a battle I can win on my own._

That’s why I’m asking you, Peter:

| |

Friend,
I have some absolutely incredible news: [**For the second consecutive filing period, we have outraised our opponent!**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=879c09d9af&e=606d7e9aa2)**** We raised **$12,795** from **82 contributors** , while our opponent raised **$8,198** from only **12 contributors.**
When we launched this campaign, **the political establishment wrote us off**. They looked at our opponent's war chest and the endless special interest money flowing their way and **declared this race over before it even began**. They said we couldn’t compete. They said we couldn’t build a grassroots movement strong enough to challenge that kind of power.
Thanks to dedicated supporters like you making small-dollar donations, we didn't just keep pace, we surged past them again. Honestly, **we should not be in this good of a position** right now. This is a testament to the fact that people power still matters.

### Now for the Final Push: GOTV
###
This financial victory is thrilling, but it's only a momentum builder. We can’t allow this hard work and these historic wins to stop short of the finish line.
The final, most critical step is **Get Out The Vote (GOTV)**. This is how we staff our phone banks, launch our final canvassing blitzes, and make sure every single person who believes in our movement actually casts a ballot. This is how we convert momentum into victory.
[We are currently **$2,358 short** of fully funding that crucial GOTV operation.](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=9f610b34a9&e=606d7e9aa2)
That is a small gap for such a massive goal. Just **$2,358** is all that stands between us and ensuring we have the resources needed to mobilize our community and secure our win on Election Day.
[If you can chip in $5, $25, or whatever you can afford, we can close this small deficit today and launch our final, game-changing push.](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=dc8f20b8cb&e=606d7e9aa2)

---

We’ve proven that we are the **stronger, smarter, and more dedicated campaign**. Let's not let a small funding gap keep us from securing the victory we’ve fought so hard for.
Thank you for believing in what we can achieve together!
In Solidarity,
Dr. Gary P. MillerDemocratic NomineeHouse of Delegates 49

---
| [SIGN ME UP! I Want to Help End Property Taxes for Seniors!](https://howellforharriscounty.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8c3a643a45a6e2b06d8f050&id=55bdce910f&e=7c92d84deb)
---
| |
Dear Friends and Neighbors,

I’m Warren Howell, and I’m running for Harris County Judge because I believe that leadership means standing up for the people who built this community and truly _leading_ Harris County in Commissioners Court.
Too many of our Seniors, folks who’ve spent their lives working, raising families, and giving back to Harris County, are now struggling to keep their homes because of ever-rising property taxes.
**That’s not fair, and it’s not the kind of community I want to lead.**
That’s why I’m committed to introducing a **Resolution on Day 1 to **_**eliminate**_** Local and Municipal Property Taxes for our Seniors over 65**. It’s a simple idea: no one who has spent a lifetime in pursuit of the American Dream of homeownership should ever fear losing that very home in their Golden Years.
_**NO ONE ELSE INCLUDES THIS CRITICAL ITEM IN THEIR PLATFORM.**_
Help me get our message out and build the momentum that we need to win, I’m asking for your help.
If you believe, like I do, that Harris County should protect and honor its Seniors, please chip in whatever you can today:
👉 [**Will you chip in $50, $100, or whatever you can to ensure**](https://howellforharriscounty.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ab8c3a643a45a6e2b06d8f050&id=2ed45be790&e=7c92d84deb)**that my message is heard?**
Together we can build a Harris County that is fair and prosperous; one with true transparency and accountability for ever tax dollar.
As I like to say, let’s DOGE Harris County!
Sincerely,**Warren Howell for Harris County Judge**

| | , I’m honored to share some exciting news from this past weekend. The **State Tejano Democrats** held their 2026 straw poll, and our campaign for Texas Attorney General received **91% of the vote.** This overwhelming show of support from one of Texas’s most influential grassroots organizations sends a powerful message: Texans want leadership that listens, learns, and delivers—not politics as usual. As **Juanita Martinez** , 2nd Vice-Chair of the State Tejano Democrats, said:
> _**“Joe Jaworski doesn’t just drop in for a photo op — he listens, learns, and fights for our families.”**_
I’m deeply grateful for that trust. Our campaign is built on the belief that _every_ Texan deserves a fair shot, honest leadership, and an Attorney General who will fight corruption, defend our freedoms, and serve the **people** , not political insiders.

In contrast, my opponent supported Proposition 16 on this November's ballot — a MAGA-backed “show me your papers” law that insults Latino voters and spreads the false claim that noncitizens are voting in Texas. I believe Texans deserve better. But we’re just getting started, and this momentum only matters if we keep it going. # How we can help our community when the administration cuts SNAP benefits on November 1
---
[|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=bff3506aa1&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |

Nearly 40,000 people depend on SNAP in Spartanburg County. The Trump administration refuses to use federal emergency funds to bridge the program, and Gov McMaster has called on ‘charities’ to do the heavy lifting in our state.
The food banks are receiving an enormous amount of calls from individuals looking for food assistance. Not surprisingly, we are also receiving an increase in calls from people who want to help by distributing food. However, Food Banks have a strong network of partners in place who can distribute food quickly. What they need are people who can collect food and/or funds. Donate to your local food bank, pantry, and soup kitchens.
Money is always great but if that’s not possible, donate food. Shelf stable food is best. Consider organizing a food collection within your businesses, schools, and neighborhoods. [You can find a list of local places to support here.](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=8cf19c07a0&e=edbde6c9b1)

– Canned fruit
– Pasta sauce
– Breakfast items, mainly cereal
– Canned peas
– Canned carrots
– Canned mixed veggies
– Canned meat
– Pop top cans are helpful when available

# [Here’s why the administration’s shutdown has put SNAP at risk](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=02968d2983&e=edbde6c9b1)

| |

In an unprecedented situation, millions of Americans could **lose access** to a crucial food assistance program in the coming weeks amid the federal government shutdown.The US Department of Agriculture has said it does not have the money to pay $8 billion in food stamp benefits for November amid the funding impasse on Capitol Hill that led the government to shut down on October 1. The agency argues it cannot tap into its roughly **$6 billion contingency fund** to cover next month’s benefits, though Democratic lawmakers and advocates claim the USDA should — or is even obligated to — use the money.Without help from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or SNAP, the formal name for food stamps, many recipients are going to have to decide whether to use their limited budgets to buy groceries, pay rent, fill prescriptions or turn on the heat, said Ed Bolen, director of state SNAP strategies for the left-leaning Center on Budget and Policy Priorities.[**Read More**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=7043567ec7&e=edbde6c9b1)

Last Thursday I joined Emerge SC for their Women of the Year Award ceremony to honor Adair Ford Boroughs, Courtney Waters, and Inez Tenenbaum. It was an inspiring evening that reminded me there is a path forward for all of us.
We had an amazing turnout for door knocking this past weekend followed by our annual PRIDE celebration in downtown Spartanburg. Don’t forget you can vote early this week through Halloween and election day is November 4.
Democracy is a participatory experience, join me at [kathrynforcouncil.com](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=b543a0f0e2&e=edbde6c9b1).

A weekly digest covering South Carolina politics and opportunities for engagement and action in the Upstate. | | Head to the polls by October 31 | | We’ve left it all out on the field this election, and I’m grateful for your support. We’re pushing to sending out one more mailer before election day, November 4. Can you ? Remember early voting takes place through October 31 at 366 North Church St. | | | How we can help our community when the administration cuts SNAP benefits on November 1 | | Nearly 40,000 people depend on SNAP in Spartanburg County. The Trump administration refuses to use federal emergency funds to bridge the program, and Gov McMaster has called on ‘charities’ to do the heavy lifting in our state. The food banks are receiving an enormous amount of calls from individuals looking for food assistance. Not surprisingly, we are also receiving an increase in calls from people who want to help by distributing food. However, Food Banks have a strong network of partners in place who can distribute food quickly. What they need are people who can collect food and/or funds. Donate to your local food bank, pantry, and soup kitchens. Money is always great but if that’s not possible, donate food. Shelf stable food is best. Consider organizing a food collection within your businesses, schools, and neighborhoods. – Soups – Complete Meals – Canned fruit – Pasta sauce – Breakfast items, mainly cereal – Canned peas – Canned carrots – Canned mixed veggies – Canned meat – Pop top cans are helpful when available | | | We need poll greeters on election day! Remove exceptions for rape, incest, or fatal fetal anomaly. Redefine embryos as full legal persons, threatening contraception, IVF, and miscarriage care. Impose felony penalties up to 30 years on physicians and medical providers. Criminalize helping someone travel out of state for abortion care. Gag doctors and advocates from sharing accurate medical information — even online. | | | | | | In an unprecedented situation, millions of Americans could lose access to a crucial food assistance program in the coming weeks amid the federal government shutdown.The US Department of Agriculture has said it does not have the money to pay $8 billion in food stamp benefits for November amid the funding impasse on Capitol Hill that led the government to shut down on October 1. Slate just asked: “How can Democrats make their comeback?”
And they point to someone with the answers: Cori Bush.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-25q4?refcode=x_251029_slate_eom3_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-25q4?refcode=x_251029_slate_eom3_act]
Because here’s the problem: too many Democrats stopped listening to their communities. Instead, they started listening to consultants, pollsters, and billionaires.
Meanwhile, families have been crying out for help while corporate interests write the checks and call the shots.
That’s how we lose elections. That’s how we lose people’s trust.
Cori’s solution is simple and powerful: put people first. Listen to our communities, not big money. Prioritize wallets, not donors. Be loud, be bold, and fight for what’s right – even when it’s not popular.
That’s what Cori’s campaign is all about.
When you're loud, bold, and fight for what's right, those billionaires will come for you. They've done it before, and they'll do it again. That's why it's so IMPERATIVE that we hit our goal this month – the first real test to show we have the grassroots strength to take on the same big-money machines that spent $15 million trying to silence Cori last year.
If we don't have the resources to take them on, we won't be able to win for families, and that means building a real campaign right this second.
If we want a comeback built by the people and not bought by corporate PACs, it starts right here, right now.
Can you chip in before midnight on Friday to help Cori fight for the people of St. Louis and for a Democratic Party that actually listens? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-25q4?refcode=x_251029_slate_eom3_act]

| | | | Hi Peter, While Gov. Bill Lee and Republicans handed out $140 million in private school vouchers to wealthy families, they cut the summer food program for at-risk children across our state—leaving more than 200,000 Tennessee children without food assistance this summer.
In 2024, over 40% of families with children reported food insecurity. 71% of families surveyed said they had to change food spending habits due to high prices. (_Vanderbilt Child Health Poll_)
These aren’t just numbers. They’re Tennessee children!
Cutting the summer food program wasn’t just cruel. It was a conscious choice by Bill Lee and Republicans to make children go hungry. And we refuse to accept that from the leadership of our state.
Our Caucus is fighting to provide free universal school meals and protect another generation from having to pay the price for GOP policies. But to win these battles, we need grassroots supporters like you who believe no child should go hungry. **Chip in today to help us fight for Tennessee’s kids.**

2021. New evidence shows that then-Attorney General Merrick
Garland, then-Deputy Attorney General Lisa Monaco, and then-FBI
Director Christopher Wray signed off on the launch of the Arctic Frost
inquiry.

We're now **29 days into a government shutdown**. For perspective, the longest U.S. shutdown lasted 35 days, back in 2018-2019\. While Republicans and Democrats trade blame, millions of Americans are bearing the cost.

By week's end, the pain will start to feel more real.
Service members won't see their next paycheck, as the [$130 million private donation](https://substack.com/redirect/eb7db407-73cb-4b20-a4ca-3b9d2cfb53c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) accepted by the Pentagon won't cover it. Grocery budgets that rely on SNAP will vanish. Families who buy health insurance through the Affordable Care Act will face rising premiums just as open enrollment begins. Even air travel is beginning to buckle under the weight of the shutdown--just in time for the holidays.
It's stunning that for a nation that can broker ceasefires abroad, we still can't reach an agreement in Washington that keeps the lights on for families at home.
