# Leadership in the States
With moral leadership in short supply in Washington, it's the states that are carrying the torch. Governors like Josh Shapiro in Pennsylvania, Wes Moore in Maryland, and Spencer Cox in Utah are reminding the country what decency and accountability in public service look like. Cox has built a platform around how to ["disagree better."](https://substack.com/redirect/d8326684-4df4-46cf-87de-6f1853bb74e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now, that same kind of principled leadership could soon extend even further.
Two of the most closely watched races next Tuesday feature women warriors with national security backgrounds: Abigail Spanberger in Virginia and Mikie Sherrill in New Jersey--both running for governor in their respective states. (Disclosure: my PAC, Taking the Hill, endorsed Sherrill and contributed to her campaign.)
Spanberger, a former CIA officer, made her name in 2018 when she flipped a deep-red district in central Virginia during the first midterms of the Trump administration--a year when Democrats gained 40 seats nationally. She's now leading in the polls to become Virginia's first female governor.
Sherrill, a former Navy helicopter pilot and federal prosecutor, was also part of that 2018 wave. A new [Gallup survey](https://substack.com/redirect/51ad735b-434a-4641-9acb-63ea9128de4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found that **55% of Americans value military service more than other backgrounds when choosing candidates for office.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/79ad7f33-9e46-48b3-87dc-fff715f740b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Her home state of NJ is now bracing for the fallout of Washington's gridlock. Open enrollment on the Affordable Care Act marketplace begins this Friday, but without the healthcare subsidy extension that Democrats have been fighting for, middle-class families will see a major spike in their premiums.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3da50ed-200f-4541-b8a2-ba66c2990700?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If there's one thing this moment demands, it's courage through leadership. These two women have it in spades.
Together, these women are continuing the spirit of that 2018 class, which included the "Fab Four" from Pennsylvania. Among them was Madeleine Dean, whose campaign I proudly chaired. They represent a new generation of leadership.
# The Need for More Women Warriors
Many of you know, when I was leading the Army as Acting Secretary, we opened up every Army job to women, including **[Ranger School](https://substack.com/redirect/e9da50ba-cbb7-426f-818c-380e85380695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --one of the toughest infantry leadership programs in the world. I was clear to the American public and Senate Armed Services Chairman John McCain in my testimony, our military is a meritocracy. Half of our recruitment pool are women, and they are more than ready to serve in combat roles. We would hold everyone to one standard--and now, thousands of women have admirably and successfully stepped up to fill those ranks.
That change paved the way for trailblazers like Capt. Kristen Griest, 1st Lt. Shaye Haver, and Maj. Lisa Jaster, the first women to earn the coveted Ranger tab. Their success proved what we already knew: our women warriors are just as resilient and essential as their male counterparts.
I see that same spirit in my daughter Maggie, who just passed her Air Force ROTC fitness test--11:35 for the mile-and-a-half run, 28 pushups and 39 sit-ups in one minute for each event. Who knows if Maggie will go on to a military career, but giving her options and role models like them sure as hell makes a difference.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0300e6d1-1ad8-4971-983c-6f3327b87fa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Maggie at her 5:50 am run
One of these Women Warriors, [Charlotte Levine](https://substack.com/redirect/8b88f944-5c90-467f-b18b-b3a0fa1fb887?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), successfully transitioned into business, and we profiled her on ['Warrior Money.'](https://substack.com/redirect/8b88f944-5c90-467f-b18b-b3a0fa1fb887?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Charlotte is a Cornell Army ROTC grad, one of the Army's first Armor Officers, who crushed it for our Army for over seven years as a Tank Platoon Leader, Scout Platoon Leader, and went on to Harvard Business School, then Chief Strategy Officer at NY/NJ Gotham Football Club and now Bain Capital. She said it herself, if you see it, you can be it. While only 17% of the US military are women, Congress isn't much better at 19% in the US House, 20% in the US Senate, and, shockingly, only 10% of the Fortune 500 CEOs are women.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8b88f944-5c90-467f-b18b-b3a0fa1fb887?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# Trump Tours Asia
This past week, President Trump has been touring Asia, casting himself as a dealmaker while the most urgent deals back here at home are being ignored.
He began his trip in [Malaysia](https://substack.com/redirect/3ecfb274-70b1-415c-9480-ca452fe4e01f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), brokering a ceasefire between Thailand and Cambodia, before landing in [Tokyo](https://substack.com/redirect/952faf26-046d-4f93-8e04-396488591f64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to meet Japan's newly elected--and first female--prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, who said she would nominate him for the Nobel Peace Prize.
Aboard the USS George Washington, Trump addressed thousands of American troops, declaring, This is all good and well if we weren't facing such dysfunction from our own government.
Next, Trump heads to[ South Korea](https://substack.com/redirect/a742bd35-a338-4573-9843-a2f0982d10d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping to discuss trade, technology, and regional security.
I'm all for this overseas work, and American politics should stop at our water's edge, but you cannot forget the Homefront when millions are out of work while Congress and those in the White House are still collecting their paychecks.
# Early Voting is Underway
Local elections are next Tuesday, Nov 4th! If you are registered to vote, make sure you have a plan to cast your ballot. The foundation of our democracy is built on local government. It's easy to tune out in non-presidential years, but local government is just as important.
City councils decide on local infrastructure and public safety.

School boards shape the education of the next generation.

Mayors ensure our cities run properly.

State legislators set policy for everything from healthcare to reproductive rights.

And governors lead, especially when Washington grinds to a halt. They define their state's identity far more than any federal agency.
During these moments, it's easy to fall into despair, but there's still so much we can do to improve the quality of life in this country.
Right now, the most powerful thing you can do is very simple:

**Vote in this week 's election **(Tues, Nov 4)**.**
And vote early if you can.
You can find your polling place [here.](https://substack.com/redirect/e1cc8597-1652-49db-83eb-6caadc3caae6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Kristen Griest, 1st Lt. Shaye Haver, and Maj. Lisa Jaster, the first women to earn the coveted Ranger tab. Their success proved what we already knew: our women warriors are just as resilient and essential as their male counterparts. I see that same spirit in my daughter Maggie, who just passed her Air Force ROTC fitness test--11:35 for the mile-and-a-half run, 28 pushups and 39 sit-ups in one minute for each event. Who knows if Maggie will go on to a military career, but giving her options and role models like them sure as hell makes a difference. | | ---|---|--- Maggie at her 5:50 am run One of these Women Warriors, , successfully transitioned into business, and we profiled her on Charlotte is a Cornell Army ROTC grad, one of the Army's first Armor Officers, who crushed it for our Army for over seven years as a Tank Platoon Leader, Scout Platoon Leader, and went on to Harvard Business School, then Chief Strategy Officer at NY/NJ Gotham Football Club and now Bain Capital. She said it herself, if you see it, you can be it. While only 17% of the US military are women, Congress isn't much better at 19% in the US House, 20% in the US Senate, and, shockingly, only 10% of the Fortune 500 CEOs are women. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. Trump Tours Asia This past week, President Trump has been touring Asia, casting himself as a dealmaker while the most urgent deals back here at home are being ignored. He began his trip in , brokering a ceasefire between Thailand and Cambodia, before landing in to meet Japan's newly elected--and first female--prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, who said she would nominate him for the Nobel Peace Prize. Aboard the USS George Washington, Trump addressed thousands of American troops, declaring, This is all good and well if we weren't facing such dysfunction from our own government. Next, Trump heads to to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping to discuss trade, technology, and regional security. I'm all for this overseas work, and American politics should stop at our water's edge, but you cannot forget the Homefront when millions are out of work while Congress and those in the White House are still collecting their paychecks. Early Voting is Underway Local elections are next Tuesday, Nov 4th! If you are registered to vote, make sure you have a plan to cast your ballot. The foundation of our democracy is built on local government. It's easy to tune out in non-presidential years, but local government is just as important. City councils decide on local infrastructure and public safety. School boards shape the education of the next generation. Mayors ensure our cities run properly. State legislators set policy for everything from healthcare to reproductive rights. And governors lead, especially when Washington grinds to a halt. They define their state's identity far more than any federal agency. During these moments, it's easy to fall into despair, but there's still so much we can do to improve the quality of life in this country. Right now, the most powerful thing you can do is very simple: Vote in this week 's election (Tues, Nov 4).** And vote early if you can. But what Trump did for Argentina was actually a nasty three-part betrayal of Colorado farmers, cattle ranchers, and American taxpayers:

1. Trump's Treasury Department wrote Argentina a blank check for $20 billion to stabilize their currency
2. Argentina, looking to support their own farmers, immediately sold massive amounts of soybeans to China at favorable prices, since Trump's trade war has made American soybeans more expensive and less desirable abroad
3. Trump then announced that the U.S. would be allowing 4x the import of Argentinian beef with lower tariffs -- a move that will devastate American cattle ranchers

The betrayal is so galling, and so deep, that even staunch Trump ally Marjorie Taylor Greene has come out and publicly called it a "punch in the gut" to American cattle ranchers and the so-called "America First" movement.
There is not a single constituency in my district, the place where I grew up, the land that inspired my first love of nature, conservation, the place I call home ... that supports what Trump is doing here.
Boebert and MAGA are showing rural Americans what they truly care about: wealthy donors, billionaires, and themselves. Not the people.
But this isn't a joke. It isn't a lost cause. We are not pandering to the American farmer with false promises of economic riches and prosperity. We are talking cold, hard realities.
Boebert is beyond vulnerable and 2026 is the year we remove her. I served our nation in the US Marine Corps as an electrician & a diesel mechanic. I kept my brothers & sisters on the move and equipped to DEFEND our nation from terrorists & communists. It was during my service that I learned what real leadership and sacrifice are. _**I am forever grateful that I had the privilege to serve and defend our nation, Fellow American.**_

There's a saying: _Once a Marine, always a Marine._ Every Marine shares the same spirit of duty and service that inspired me to join--to defend our neighbors and our nation. That's why, today, I'm still serving my country.

But now, I'm fighting for my friends' and neighbors' freedoms as a civilian. In 2021, I decided to run for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia because I saw that our nation needed a strong Christian, someone who has served this great country, to step up and LEAD!

**And after a historic and hard-fought battle, my team and I won by LESS THAN 1.6% of the vote!!** Now, Democrats want me _GONE_. It doesn't matter that I'm a patriotic Marine, a strong Christian, and a mom & grandma; _the Left can 't stand me because I am a proud and unapologetic conservative!_

# Tiktoker released without bail after reportedly placing hit on Pam Bondi's head
Tyler Maxon Avalos, 30, of St. Paul, Minnesota, **[was arrested by the FBI for posting a $45,000 bounty](https://substack.com/redirect/bbf7150b-0ac3-4780-9aae-c256dfb69aa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on TikTok targeting Attorney General Pam Bondi with a "sniper-scope red dot" on her head and the words "WANTED: Pam Bondi. REWARD: 45,000. DEAD OR ALIVE (PREFERABLY DEAD)" but was released on October 22 after signing a personal recognizance bond.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bbf7150b-0ac3-4780-9aae-c256dfb69aa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Judge orders GPS monitoring and strict conditions:** Judge Elizabeth Cowan Wright released Avalos with GPS monitoring, ordering him to continue mental health treatment and prohibiting him from using computers or online services without probation officer approval, as well as banning drug and alcohol use, firearm possession, and requiring submission to a curfew and property searches.
* **Suspect has violent criminal history and anarchist ties:** Avalos has convictions across multiple states including a 2022 felony stalking conviction in Minnesota, a 2016 felony third-degree domestic battery conviction in Florida, and a 2016 misdemeanor domestic assault conviction, while his TikTok page featured a link to an anarchist FAQ book advocating for the abolition of state and capitalist institutions.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/910626ea-fdd5-4c4a-9ad8-0cea8fb0e698?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# Long Island Republican threatens to thwart Mamdani by hiring more police & partnering with ICE
Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman, a Republican up for re-election in Long Island NY, **[promised to hire more police officers and increase cooperation with ICE](https://substack.com/redirect/4dd09ebf-8807-48f7-a44c-8f1cf26eae94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** if democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani wins the NYC mayoral race, in an effort to attract residents and businesses to move from the city to Nassau County.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4dd09ebf-8807-48f7-a44c-8f1cf26eae94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Aims to market Nassau as "safest county in America":** Blakeman's spokesman Chris Boyle said the county executive would "actively encourage people and businesses to move to the safest county in America" in the event of a Mamdani victory, though he didn't provide further details on how Nassau would ramp up its ICE partnership.
* **Controversial ICE agreement already in place:** Nassau's current deal with ICE, signed in February, has sparked lawsuits from activists and criticism from Democrats, contrasting with other municipalities' "sanctuary policies," with the county having deputized 10 detectives to work with ICE and held 3,000 detainees in its local lockup.
* **Democratic challenger opposes ICE partnership:** Blakeman's Democratic opponent, Nassau Legislator Seth Koslow, has pledged to end the ICE deal if he unseats the Republican front-runner, while Mamdani leads the NYC mayoral race as the Democratic nominee against independent Andrew Cuomo and Republican Curtis Sliwa.

# Don Lemon calls Megyn Kelly "trans" in disgraceful podcast rant
### _" The Left is using 'Trans' as an insult now?"_
Former CNN anchor Don Lemon **[called conservative commentator Megyn Kelly"trans"](https://substack.com/redirect/9d60c42c-2f5d-49fa-9c73-3af47a9eed38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and "clockable" (a tactless term for trans people identifiable as their biological gender) on his "Clip Farmers" podcast while discussing the appearance of "MAGA ladies," despite having grandstanded against transphobia in the past.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9d60c42c-2f5d-49fa-9c73-3af47a9eed38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Critics blast hypocrisy on social media:** Lemon's comments drew immediate backlash online, with critics accusing him of two-faced behavior, with one user posting "For a man who praises trans people, #DonLemon sure feels comfortable using trans as an insult" and others questioning "The Left is using 'Trans' as an insult now?"
* **Past advocacy for LGBTQ rights highlighted:** The insult stands in stark contrast to Lemon's previous loud advocacy for LGBTQ rights, including his 2023 speech at the Son Awards railing against anti-trans legislation and "transphobia," his defense of Dylan Mulvaney during the Bud Light controversy, and his emotional support for a transgender woman nervous about the 2024 election before he was fired from CNN in 2023 for alleged misogynistic behavior.

# Trump becomes first president to receive South Korea's highest honor
President Trump finished out his five day Asia tour Tuesday with **[South Korean President](https://substack.com/redirect/ab4745df-fa8c-443d-b07e-c6d4ef0cca67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Lee Jae Myung in Gyeongju, and became the first US president to receive **[South Korea's highest honor.](https://substack.com/redirect/74a90aec-c7f6-4a0b-a4c4-6cf7be88dc04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b60f6e8a-56b7-440b-ab49-54467f840fcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **South Korea crowns Trump:** President Trump received a large gold crown from South Korean President Lee Jae Myung during his visit, with Lee declaring a new "golden age" for the US-South Korea alliance.
* **Trump receives the highest honor for diplomacy:** Trump also accepted the Grand Order of Mugungwha, South Korea's highest honor, which Lee said recognized Trump's diplomatic efforts with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
* **Nityy-gritty Negotiations:** During bilateral talks, Lee requested Trump's approval for nuclear fuel to power South Korean submarines and noted that technically "a war is going on" on the Korean peninsula, pledging increased military spending.
* **Trump 's Economic Maneuvers**: Trump announced he secured roughly $490 billion in investment commitments from Japan earlier this week and is pursuing an additional $350 billion from South Korea, predicting total new investment could reach $22 trillion by the end of his first year back in office. Trump also expressed confidence about reaching a prosperous deal on the upcoming meeting with President Xi of China, happening today.

As you read this, Jon Ossoff has been _absolutely hammered_ with attack ads in Georgia. Republicans have spent more than $10 million on TV and online already. It’s ridiculous.
Why so much money, this far from Election Day?
_Because Jon Ossoff is the only Democratic Senator running for reelection in a state Trump won._
_That_ is why Trump and the national GOP have made defeating Jon their #1 priority, and it’s why they are hitting him so hard, so early in the race.

clean_body: Our pro-choice champions are running for crucial seats in the Wisconsin state Legislature! | = Hi Peter, State legislatures control how districts are drawn, how elections are run, and how policy shapes our daily lives. And in Wisconsin, Republicans currently have control of BOTH the state Assembly and Senate. But in 2026, we are working to change that and flip both these chambers. That's why today we're endorsing our first four Democratic pro-choice women running to hold critical seats in the Wisconsin state Legislature. Each candidate is uniquely positioned to win in their district and push back against MAGA Republicans playing politics with our communities. = | = State Rep. Lori Palmeri (WI-AD54) is the former mayor of Oshkosh, an urban planner, and working mom dedicated to practical leadership and community resilience. She serves on key committees focused on environment, housing, and local government, fighting to protect Wisconsin's natural resources and improve Wisconsinites' quality of life. State Rep. Jodi Emerson (WI-AD91) is a fierce champion for Wisconsin's Chippewa Valley, fighting to make housing and child care more affordable while protecting access to reproductive health care. She's running for reelection to push back against MAGA Republicans who threaten our rights. State Rep. Robyn Vining (WI-SD05) is a proven advocate for families and climate action, and she fights every day for a brighter future for Wisconsinites. She knows what it takes to run a tough campaign — in 2018 she flipped her state Assembly seat red to blue and we know she's ready to flip this state Senate seat in 2026. State Rep. Jenna Jacobson (WI-SD17) is a dedicated public servant with a deep commitment to rural communities and education. With a background in housing stability and financial planning, Jenna fights for affordable housing, farmland preservation, and economic growth for her constituents. Peter,
While Donald Trump and his MAGA allies are dividing Americans, we’re fighting for you.
While gun violence continues to ravage our communities, we’re standing up for common sense solutions that will protect you and your loved ones.
While Donald Trump and his administration continue to spread vaccine misinformation, we’re making sure you have access to vaccines to keep our communities safe.
While the Trump administration uses the military to invade US cities, we’re working with local partners to make sure our neighbors are safe in their communities.
**It’s simple. Donald Trump is looking out for himself — but that’s not how we do things in Minnesota. We look out for our neighbors.**
If you believe in this vision of One Minnesota, I need your help. We’ve set an ambitious goal of raising $50,000 before the end of the month. I know with this team on my side we’ll be able to hit it, so now we’ve got to show our strength.

**About Steve Roberts**
Senator Steven Roberts, a fourth-generation St. Louis native, was sworn into office on January 6, 2021, to represent Missouri’s 5th Senatorial District and was selected as the Democratic Whip for the Minority Caucus. Previously, he served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and chaired the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus. A graduate of the University of Miami and Pepperdine Law, he has worked in Congress, as a prosecutor in St. Louis, and as a Captain in the Missouri Air National Guard’s JAG Corps. He also manages Roberts Law, LLC, and remains active in Missouri’s legal and civic communities.

body:
Please read my letter.
| **_A LETTER FROM THE DESK OF REP. JIM JORDAN_**
---
Friend,
---
Over the last month, Democrats have picked up two seats in special elections.
---
**Republicans are now just _ONE_ _SEAT_ over the threshold to declare a majority in the House. **
---
_That means we have almost NO ROOM for error anymore..._
---
_In the midterms, we need to not just DEFEND every single Republican seat, but we need to take the offensive to FLIP Democrat seats as well!_
---
Look – I’ll be honest with you: Our Republican House majority is the KEY to passing President Trump’s America First agenda.
---
If we lose it, the Democrats will be able to sabotage everything we’re trying to do, and they won’t stop there...
---
These radicals will attempt to IMPEACH President Trump and bring our country straight back to the days of the failed Biden-Harris agenda.
---
**Given how critical the House Majority is, I’m making you a solemn promise...**
---
I’m going to do EVERYTHING in my power to help Republicans DEFEND our razor-thin majority so we can continue Making America Great Again!
---
_...But I’m humble enough to know this isn’t a battle I can win on my own._
---
That’s why I’m asking you, Friend:
---

clean_body: Please read my letter. | A LETTER FROM THE DESK OF REP. JIM JORDAN Friend, Over the last month, Democrats have picked up two seats in special elections. Republicans are now just ONE SEAT over the threshold to declare a majority in the House. That means we have almost NO ROOM for error anymore... In the midterms, we need to not just DEFEND every single Republican seat, but we need to take the offensive to FLIP Democrat seats as well! Look – I’ll be honest with you: Our Republican House majority is the KEY to passing President Trump’s America First agenda. If we lose it, the Democrats will be able to sabotage everything we’re trying to do, and they won’t stop there... These radicals will attempt to IMPEACH President Trump and bring our country straight back to the days of the failed Biden-Harris agenda. Given how critical the House Majority is, I’m making you a solemn promise... I’m going to do EVERYTHING in my power to help Republicans DEFEND our razor-thin majority so we can continue Making America Great Again! ...But I’m humble enough to know this isn’t a battle I can win on my own. That’s why I’m asking you, Friend: Will you stand with me and House GOP Leadership Chair Elise Stefanik today by pledging a grassroots contribution to help DEFEND President Trump’s House majority? It's no longer about "preparing" for Election Day -- voters in Pennsylvania are already making their choices right now.
Mail-in ballots have hit mailboxes, and Democrats are starting to fill them out. That means every day we wait, more and more voters are returning their ballots without ever hearing the truth about what's at stake in this race. MAGA billionaires know this.
That's why their dark-money PACs have poured millions into deceptive ads and mailers designed to trick Democrats into voting the wrong way -- or staying home entirely. Defend Our Courts has the ground game ready: canvassers knocking doors, digital campaigns targeting swing counties, and rapid-response tv ads to counter the flood of disinformation. But with ballots already being cast, we can't afford to wait until November 4th. The fight is happening right now.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
If we don’t get off our butts and help Chris Pappas right now, we can kiss the Senate majority goodbye.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve been around the block a few times and worked on a heck of a lot of campaigns. So believe me when I tell you: **This ain’t good.**
John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — just jumped into the U.S. Senate race in New Hampshire. And now the political eggheads have DOWNGRADED Democrats’ chances of winning there.
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas fight back right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20251029_1_carville.JKBBJc&refcode=em20251029-1&t=1&akid=3168%2E582294%2E5yDUhM)**
Let me tell you what this means: **If we don’t get off our butts and help Chris Pappas right now, we can kiss our chances of winning back the Senate majority goodbye.**
This isn’t some back-bench, no-name guy we’re up against. **Sununu’s won a Senate seat before.**
He’s got name ID, deep pockets, and Wall Street’s dark money machine ready to drown us in attack ads. This is the right-wing’s big play, y’all — they know if they take New Hampshire, Democrats have _no viable path_ to flipping the Senate.
Chris Pappas is the real deal. I mean it. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times, and he knows how to bring folks together. But he cannot — **_cannot_** — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare. Because if we let the GOP buy this seat for Sununu, we’re gonna be stuck with Republican control for years to come.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20251029_1_carville.JKBBJc&refcode=em20251029-1&t=2&akid=3168%2E582294%2E5yDUhM)**
**[Chip in Now »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251029_1_carville.682D9F&refcode=em20251029-1&t=3&akid=3168%2E582294%2E5yDUhM)**
I’m mad as HELL that this race just shifted in the wrong direction — but that means it’s time to get serious. Chris is the only one who can hold this seat, but he needs a hell of a lot more firepower to fend off what’s coming.
Let’s show these Republican bigshots that we’re not scared — and we sure as hell ain’t backing down.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20251029_1_carville.JKBBJc&refcode=em20251029-1&t=4&akid=3168%2E582294%2E5yDUhM)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. The recent Wilder, Idaho raid that nabbed 105 illegal aliens at an illegal gambling operation has unleashed the predictable wave of gaslighting from the left.
_" Government overreach!" _
_" Innocent families!"_
_" Children were traumatized!"1 _
_**But here 's what they refuse to discuss: the mountain of federal crimes these "innocent" people commit just by living here illegally**_.
While unlawful presence itself is technically a civil matter, the moment someone decides to build a life in America without authorization, they enter a world of cascading criminal violations that touch every aspect of daily existence.
Let's dive in, shall we?
Cross the border illegally and you've committed a federal misdemeanor under [8 U.S.C. § 1325](https://substack.com/redirect/f3c06b99-6370-47b1-83b3-0fed5914ea9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Get deported and return is a felony under [§ 1326](https://substack.com/redirect/5b121c01-42b9-46a8-83e9-4f13f3bea5c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with penalties up to twenty years if your criminal record is extensive enough.
To hold a job in America, you need a Social Security number (ish). Since illegal aliens can't legally obtain one, an estimated seventy-five percent resort to using numbers that belong to someone else (identity theft under [42 U.S.C. § 408](https://substack.com/redirect/ee70e0de-6130-4435-8eb0-59f44ab6071e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), another felony).
The human cost is staggering...
Millions of Americans open their mail to discover wages they never earned, debts they never incurred, and benefits claimed under their stolen identities. Meanwhile, the thief is somewhere else, cashing paychecks under a name that isn't theirs.
## The Document Mill
Supporting this system requires an entire infrastructure of fraudulent documents. Fake green cards, fake visas, fake birth certificates, and fake Social Security cards flow through criminal networks nationwide.
[18 U.S.C. § 1546](https://substack.com/redirect/8c70622f-125c-4c2c-9bba-804393aa1373?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) makes each of these forgeries a felony carrying ten to twenty-five years. ICE raids routinely collect hundreds of these documents in single operations. The criminal organizations that produce them face additional conspiracy charges adding five to ten years.
Now what about the "Parents of the Year" living here illegally?
School enrollment requires documentation and often Social Security numbers or Taxpayer Identification Numbers obtained through false statements about legal status. Medicaid applications for children involve similar lies about eligibility and status. Tax filings to claim child tax credits require TINs obtained by lying about immigration status on federal forms.
Each of these constitutes mail fraud, wire fraud, or benefits fraud under [18 U.S.C. §§ 1341 and 1343](https://substack.com/redirect/0e16a557-e708-41fc-9cfd-a8f5c60cc572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), adding more felonies to the pile.
There's even an entire industry that coaches pregnant women to lie on visa applications, having them swear under oath that they're visiting America for brief tourism while actually planning to give birth here (and under current court orders, the child still receives U.S. citizenship). But the mother's lie on her visa application creates a permanent legal bar to future immigration benefits under immigration law, even if she later marries a U.S. citizen. Oh, and, the visa fraud also constitutes a felony offense.
## The American Cost
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a5fef9-fb49-41ab-8b07-2346dec2f092?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
These aren't victimless crimes...
American citizens foot the tax bills for services they're not receiving. Victims of identity theft lose benefits and watch their credit scores collapse. The integrity of federal programs gets undermined. Law enforcement resources get diverted to process fraudulent documents.
Yet, despite this mountain of evidence, we're told _" they're not committing crimes."_
This is industrial-scale gaslighting of the American people. The law is clear. The violations are documented. The victims are real.
_**The path forward requires acknowledging reality.**_
Deport them. Prosecute every felony. Seal the border.
Put Americans first.
1
_Of course children were traumatized. That 's what happens when criminal parents drag their kids to illegal gambling operations run by cartels._

No wonder 90% of traders lose money. Here's what actually works: Learn by doing. | | | | [ ](https://links.e.stockmarkethour.com/u/click?_t=7269806ab0c84d628a5ecc683cb34168&_m=7f47cdb8355d4071ad3c103c023cc63c&_e=zpKIbfoUEje7h301mzgzsc4PaTQumONar10r1D8lsv2CLbVywejP7HMDG3ONcqPTDQM7IbRq-2kbK3remz6NGQrokqavHFTZkb_7wyb6VImlOHa59Bt6T0ZT_S1KodelQ5rz7uRzl7XR3adNwptlJJlek0YREQAwnqSHRcx9ou3tO8ouVLUdxx_LeYPlToj2rNOGWTUazDnno-SAoUJRNUm42ftR8iSLeYJjCSJ891HcNMvraBWI4K6o3n8SYXREncFwLCdQouBzJ6NI-oHxEs5afq054QunwMuVzxskiIUoGDMXSo7XjexV3eOyMPj-)

**30 days to better trading (3 trades per week)**
| |
---
Most trading education is backwards.

They teach you 47 different strategies, throw charts at you for hours, and expect you to figure it out on your own.

No wonder 90% of traders lose money.

Here's what actually works: **Learn by doing.**

That's why I created the 3-Trade Micro-Challenge.

**30 days. 3 trades per week. Zero guesswork.**

You don't sit through long seminars. You follow real trades, see real results, then join me live each week to break down exactly what happened.

It's like having a 20-year trading veteran looking over your shoulder, explaining every decision in real time.

Here's how it works:

* Monday: Get trade alert #1 (with full explanation)
* Wednesday: Trade alert #2
* Friday: Trade alert #3
* Weekend: Live Trading Lab debrief session

Rinse and repeat for 4 weeks.

By the end, you'll have seen 12 real trades and know exactly why each one was chosen.

Your first trade? Completely free.

Representative Nancy Mace is America First and she's running for GOVERNOR!

# LAW AND ORDER. ILLEGAL ALIENS. LOW TAXES. DONALD TRUMP. MILITARY VETERANS. AMERICA 1ST. MAGA MACE.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | I am MAGA Mace. An unapologetic America First conservative who fights every single day for the people, not the politically elite. I don’t bow to the establishment, I don’t play Washington games, and I don’t take orders from the media or the swamp. Which means I have no friends, well, with the exception of my 5 year old pup Liberty, she’s the only friend I need in DC.

My loyalty is to the American people — to our workers, our families, our veterans, and our freedom.
Growing up, if you were scared of my Dad’s bark, you knew not to mess with my Mom’s bite. Dad was a retired Army General and mom was a school teacher.
At the age of 17, I learned that dropping out of high school was not the best idea. My parents’ said to me, “if you stop going to school, you’re going to start going to work.” So, I took my first job at a fine-dining establishment, some of you may know as the Waffle House. Denny's was a little too high brow. While Waffle House was an important part of my journey, it would not be my destination.
I soon went from making waffles to making history. 25 years ago this high school dropout became the first woman to graduate from The Citadel. A college campus where we don't BURN American flags... we SALUTE them!
The Citadel broke me down and built me back up, and ultimately gave me the courage I would later need to take on life’s challenges, not just for myself, but for those I am honored to humbly serve.
Ever since I first ran for office, I’ve puzzled everyone from the media to my Washington colleagues. They want to know “whose side is Nancy Mace on?”
Many in Washington could never dream outside the false dichotomy of right versus left. But as is often the case, the simplest explanation is usually the correct one: I am on your side. I am on the side of the American people.
In a time when our nation feels divided, I am reminded politics doesn’t define who we are. Our values define who we are. And God transcends ALL politics.
My family never gave up on me. And I never gave up on me. More importantly, God never gave up on me. God has given me many second chances.
I am **standing** here as living proof that by the grace of God, if you have a dream, you can **stand** tall and be what God gave you purpose to be.
I get in some tough spots. I get in some tough fights. For better or worse, I get in the mix.
So my gratitude today goes to God, my gratitude goes to my family and my gratitude goes to the American people for always having my back.
The radical left wants to destroy what makes this country great: our faith, our borders, our Constitution, and our God-given rights. I will never let that happen. I stand for law and order, election integrity, energy independence, and the hard-working men and women who built this nation.
**I am fighting to make America strong, safe, and proud again. The days of weak leadership and political correctness are over. This is a new era of bold, fearless, America First action, and I’m leading from the front.****
**Sincerely,

name: Derrick Van Orden
subject: Patty cake patty cake
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Van Orden for Congress
body:
I knew there was a lot of corruption in DC before I took office. I knew there was a lot of thumb-twiddling and lollygagging. But I didn't know how bad it was.

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zdv1cm7hjlqrgjh2a4n013f17gsbtq92evuab3uo_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctjm8or0c3h2bs) I'm not here to play patty cake, Friend.
I first ran for office for the same reason that I joined the US Navy; I wanted to serve our country. And just like when I served our country as a Navy SEAL for over two decades, I have given everything I've got during my time in Congress. It's the greatest honor I have ever had and I'm so grateful to folks like you who always have my back and keep me in this fight.
Unfortunately, too many of my colleagues don't share the same sense of duty or understand the gravity of our jobs. We have been elected to govern the greatest nation in history. American taxpayers did not send their representatives to DC to line their pockets or just play patty cake!
I knew there was a lot of corruption in DC before I took office. I knew there was a lot of thumb-twiddling and lollygagging. But I didn't know how bad it was.
I can tell you from firsthand experience; DC has a lot of problems. It takes a veteran's focus and a Navy SEAL's true sense of duty to serve his country to get anything done around here.
The Left and the RINO establishment have seen that I won't play ball and let their antics slide. They know that I came to DC on a mission and they HATE it!
A Soros-backed group has already committed over a MILLION dollars toward knocking me out of this seat. On top of that, Bernie Sanders has been campaigning for my Democrat opponent. Things are looking grim.
I'm writing you today to ask for your support. Here's my call to action: [Please donate $16 or more to help me and my Team fight off Soros and Sanders so I can keep serving you in Congress.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zlqa9pth9jgm88ikourdh54ogn8tu7ngrvbomrto_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctjm8or0c3h2bs) [ DONATE $16 NOW >> ](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z8l75j5il5soqbqivj8bv5stgh8k0lhft140ea7o_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctjm8or0c3h2bs) [ DONATE ANY AMOUNT >> ](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z1fqpu5srhh9bj27tcf78a9rjqivb2k8g31889o8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctjm8or0c3h2bs) I can't thank you enough for your prayers and support. May God bless you and may God bless our nation.
-Derrick Van Orden US Congressman | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zlmgt5d4cn357f8pc8nc86ii8rn42rphkvi8kgvg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctjm8or0c3h2bs) |

subject: I don’t take this lightly, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Gillen for NY
body:
Your trust in me means the world.

| Peter — I know that millions of people who are absolutely disgusted with Donald Trump’s presidency are looking to next month’s election to provide some hope.

I know that whether we win or lose — and believe me, it’s looking close — will set the tone for what comes next in 2026, 2028, and beyond.

I know that if we lose, Trump will just be emboldened to attack our institutions and our communities even more aggressively.

But I also know that if we win, we can start to turn the tide in a better direction. And that we will send a powerful message — to Donald Trump and to the entire country — that the American people do not accept the past nine months of cruelty and authoritarianism as our new normal.

**Peter, my first and last thought every single day is how much is riding on our success in this election. But together, I know we can get this done. We can show the country who we are and what we stand for — and rally the American people behind a future that is not dictated by Donald Trump and his right-wing allies.**

clean_body: Your trust in me means the world. | Peter — I know that millions of people who are absolutely disgusted with Donald Trump’s presidency are looking to next month’s election to provide some hope. I know that whether we win or lose — and believe me, it’s looking close — will set the tone for what comes next in 2026, 2028, and beyond. I know that if we lose, Trump will just be emboldened to attack our institutions and our communities even more aggressively. But I also know that if we win, we can start to turn the tide in a better direction. And that we will send a powerful message — to Donald Trump and to the entire country — that the American people do not accept the past nine months of cruelty and authoritarianism as our new normal. Peter, my first and last thought every single day is how much is riding on our success in this election. But together, I know we can get this done. _**Arizona's Waiting Congresswoman: **_

**Interview with Congresswoman-elect Adelita Grijalva**

The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 36
| Chuck Rocha welcomes **Congresswoman-elect Adelita Grijalva** to discuss the unprecedented delay in her swearing-in. Despite winning her **Arizona CD-7** special election over a month prior, **Speaker Johnson has refused to swear her in** , leaving 812,000 constituents without representation.

The conversation explores the potential political motivations behind the delay, including her role as the **crucial 218th vote** needed for a bipartisan **discharge petition to release the Epstein files**. Adelita also discusses her campaign strategy, how she outperformed both Kamala Harris and her late father's margins in the heavily Latino border district, and the old-school door-to-door approach that won her the race.

I served our nation in the US Marine Corps as an electrician & a diesel mechanic. I kept my brothers & sisters on the move and equipped to DEFEND our nation from terrorists & communists. It was during my service that I learned what real leadership and sacrifice are. _**I am forever grateful that I had the privilege to serve and defend our nation, Fellow American.**_

There's a saying: _Once a Marine, always a Marine._ Every Marine shares the same spirit of duty and service that inspired me to join--to defend our neighbors and our nation. That's why, today, I'm still serving my country.

But now, I'm fighting for my friends' and neighbors' freedoms as a civilian. In 2021, I decided to run for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia because I saw that our nation needed a strong Christian, someone who has served this great country, to step up and LEAD!

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it's the perfect solution at the perfect time--when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It's no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

[ ](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyUUT2vnDAQ_DWmu5OxwT4KitMhqrwoxZNeaa3xAhuZD9nm0P37yMl76VJky5nR7szsx5t5A_K0Tt9hwXbwpwnRzAiB1gnIxZ9HTNOW0owULBnBRX0p-UU0WScK19Y3gY0qsC21KnXdiEoXc6tre4PboJywTluNKCspeAO1A-lsXRfU5lUlF02ppSj5tda1cjhCoyot0ZWs4uAxpOuwrRHDExI90ZPFkF4nBbwO21L4dk5pj0zemeiZ6M_zvGbzmWSid0z0FmP6CmRyIgPjyMuslz0Micnu_njneRQvFb8_3plQR1pM3I4wIJOdfblPaEFHx8JkB-NIniDhJzHAsgNNK5PdEQ2uBnw-av7qjH25jFw8TXOyh7cXtx3Wo9m3HYYE5h8u9sN6ijMGQ47J7se234cETKh42D_Q49vH5avMIrRuP8l7ikqzik8LkP9dVfr_5z5b8SsAAP__8tezSQ)
What makes hear.com's IX hearing aid so special?

It's one of **the world 's first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it's the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com's IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids--from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming--with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

"It's not just about volume," explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. "It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize."

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity --and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

# Trump gears up for the massive China trade summit
President Donald Trump, caught on a hot mic at a South Korean state dinner, revealed his pivotal Thursday summit with China's Xi Jinping[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/211c8227-ec55-415d-a833-e47a617cb643?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[will stretch three to four hours,](https://substack.com/redirect/211c8227-ec55-415d-a833-e47a617cb643?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while predicting peace with Kim Jong Un's North Korea based on their "great" rapport.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/211c8227-ec55-415d-a833-e47a617cb643?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hot mic exposes summit length** : Trump casually disclosed to aides his Xi meeting--first since 2025 tariffs--promises trade breakthroughs for both nations saying: _**" We're going to have something that's going to be very, very satisfactory to China and to us. I think we're gonna have a -- I think it's going to be a very good meeting. I look forward to it tomorrow morning when we meet,"** _
* **Tariffs halve amid crackdown** : U.S. eyes cutting duties to 10% if Beijing curbs chemical exports of fentanyl ingredients, dropping average Chinese import duties from 55% to 45%.
* **Farmers enter trade talks** : Trump has flagged U.S. farmers as a key agenda item with Xi, signaling potential boosts to agricultural exports like soybeans hit by prior tensions.
* **Nvidia chips on table** : Exports of advanced Blackwell AI chips to China are likely going to appear in discussions, easing U.S. tech restrictions for broader deal.
* **Rare earths, Boeing, TikTok eyed** : Experts predict Beijing concessions on rare earth access , buying Boeing jets and the sale of TikTok to avert Tump's 100% U.S. tariff threat by Nov. 1.
* **Kim bromance fuels optimism** : Trump vows North Korea "will be" a nicer neighbor, eyeing future talks despite no reunion this trip. Speaking to reporters on Airforce One Trump stated: _"**I 'd love to meet with him if he'd like to meet. I got along great with Kim Jong Un. I liked him, he liked me,"**_
* **Trade pact nears with Seoul** : Trump's Asia trip, intended to build stronger ties with Pacific allies also sees U.S.-South Korea finalize a deal for $350B investments in the U.S. Trump has also urged South Korea to that a tougher stance on China, including a higher defense spend.

# Nvidia stock goes STRATOSPHERIC as they blow minds at DC tech conference
Nvidia surged past a historic **[$5 trillion valuation Wednesday,](https://substack.com/redirect/9a645b01-986a-423f-a694-5ae236039a1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** becoming the first company ever to hit the milestone amid explosive AI boom, leaving Apple and Microsoft trailing at $4 trillion each.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9a645b01-986a-423f-a694-5ae236039a1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Shares explode over 50% YTD:** The stock jumped 4%+ Wednesday after a +5% Tuesday close, capping a blistering year fueled by unrelenting AI demand.
* **$500B AI orders locked in:** CEO Jensen Huang revealed a massive chip backlog, with $500B worth of orders already locked in, **[powering Nvidia's dominance](https://substack.com/redirect/07bf5c09-1355-4a71-b758-a95cbb46ad11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
* **Seven supercomputers for Uncle Sam:** Huang announced a landmark U.S. government deal with the Energy Dept. to provide **[seven new AI supercomputers](https://substack.com/redirect/07bf5c09-1355-4a71-b758-a95cbb46ad11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to supercharge U.S. infrastructure in robotics and forecasting underscoring Nvidia's pivotal national security role in AI supremacy.
* **Made In The USA:** Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, at the GPU Technology Conference (GTC) in Washington, D.C., Tuesday, announcing full U.S. production of Blackwell AI chips in Arizona--fulfilling President Trump's national security mandate and igniting America's AI dominance.
* **Quantum Leap Unlocked:** Nvidia announced**** NVQLink a system that connects **[quantum computer chips to Nvidia GPUs,](https://substack.com/redirect/07bf5c09-1355-4a71-b758-a95cbb46ad11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** partnering with 17 quantum computing startups to help correct errors in quantum computing development of apps that will revolutionize research.

**NVIDIA 'S $1B Nokia Bombshell Ignites 22% Surge!**
Nvidia stunned the tech world Tuesday by **[snapping up a $1 billion stake in Nokia,](https://substack.com/redirect/b94d212a-7ec2-4fb3-b222-40d01afa0225?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/b94d212a-7ec2-4fb3-b222-40d01afa0225?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)catapulting Nokia's shares 22% skyward amid a blockbuster AI-6G partnership unveiled at the GTC.
* **Bolsters U.S. tech dominance** : Huang hails "AI data center in every pocket," countering China's Huawei while funding Nokia's AI pivot.
* **Massive Investment:** Nvidia invests $1B in Nokia for 5G/6G base stations using U.S. chips, aiming to oust foreign tech from global networks.
* **$1B Nokia stake ignites 6G:** The bold telecom partnership positions Nvidia at forefront of next-gen wireless revolution beyond AI chips.
* **The Nuts And Bolts Of The Deal** : Nokia will flood the market with over 166 million new shares at $6.01 each, vaulting Nvidia to second-largest shareholder status of the phone company.
* **Powers AI-native 6G networks** : Nokia will port 5G/6G software to Nvidia chips, unleashing AI-RAN for edge inferencing (AI running on smartphones not a data center) leading to smarter telecom.
* **Fuels massive RAN opportunity** : Targets $200B+ AI-RAN slice of telecom pie by 2030, with T-Mobile piloting Nvidia's ARC-Pro hardware.

**LILLY & NVIDIA UNLEASH PHARMA'S MIGHTIEST AI BEAST!**
Eli Lilly and Nvidia announced Tuesday the pharmaceutical industry's "most powerful" supercomputer, powered by 1,000+ Blackwell Ultra GPUs, it is set to **[slash the 10-year drug development timelines](https://substack.com/redirect/2001d558-33a9-4ef4-99eb-7e2a2889c130?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and revolutionize discovery will launch in January.
* **Supercomputer Powers AI Factory** : A unified high-speed network will train models on millions of experiments, acting as an "enormous microscope" for biologists to unlock impossible insights.
* **TuneLab Unlocks Sector Access** : Biotech firms will swap data via federated learning for $1B-valued AI models, fueling collaborative precision medicine breakthroughs.
* **Precision Meds by 2030** : AI agents, AI imaging, and biomarkers targeting genes/environments could lead to personalized cures and new molecules currently beyond human limits.
* **Nvidia Fuels Pharma Boom** : The partnership is intended to enable startups to skip years of R&D, promising massive cost cuts and faster patient cures industry-wide.

**NVIDIA TO FLOOD U.S. LABS WITH THOUSANDS Of GPUS!**
Nvidia has **[surged ahead in the sovereign AI race,](https://substack.com/redirect/147ef778-62da-4adb-ad87-9aa15644f7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** selling thousands of high-performance GPUs to U.S. national labs including Argonne and Los Alamos to build domestic supercomputers, shielding American AI innovation from foreign rivals amid escalating global competition.
* **Huang 's Bold Vision** - CEO declares "Sovereign AI empowers nations' own capabilities," prioritizing U.S. security, climate research.
* **Teaming With DoE Labs** - Nvidia will partner with Argonne, Los Alamos, Oak Ridge, Livermore on the seven AI supercomputers using H100, Blackwell GPUs.
* **Quantum Leap Tech** - The deployment of NVQLink to link GPU clusters with quantum systems across nine labs for error-corrected computing.
* **Cloud Power Boost** - Collaborates with Microsoft, Google for rapid cloud AI training, accelerating national lab deployments.

# Trump and Japanese PM seal Rare Earth pact against China
President Donald Trump and Japan's first female prime minister Sanae Takaichi **[signed a framework Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/33aa0986-e7b5-4f77-82b6-043bce7e36f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at Akasaka Palace to secure rare earths and critical minerals, forging diversified supply chains vital for EVs, defense and tech amid China's dominance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/33aa0986-e7b5-4f77-82b6-043bce7e36f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Forms Rapid Response Group** : Japan and the U.S. will run a joint team to spot vulnerabilities, rush emergency deliveries, and tackle disruptions in key mineral supplies.
* **Funds Mining Projects Fast** : The deal will prioritize identifying and financing battery/magnet initiatives within six months to slash China reliance.
* **Eyes Joint Stockpiling Now** : Explore shared reserves plus permitting fast-tracks to fortify economic security.
* **Golden Age Alliance Blooms** : Takaichi hails the deal as a "new golden age" in U.S.-Japan ties. Japan also pledged 250 new cherry trees for America's 250th anniversary.

President Trump[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/f118c5ee-1eec-4df3-9b92-531aef6e3091?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ignited a global minerals blitz](https://substack.com/redirect/f118c5ee-1eec-4df3-9b92-531aef6e3091?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** this month, sealing an $8.5 billion rare earths deal with Australia and pacts with Japan and Southeast Asia to shatter Beijing's stranglehold on vital defense and tech supplies amid escalating export threats.
* **China Grips Mining Monopoly** : China controls 60-70% of global extraction, 85-90% of refining, and has been weaponizing exports in an attempt to cripple U.S. industries.
* **Texas Extraction Accelerates** : New U.S. projects in Texas, Canada, and Africa are ramping up via Trump's use of Defense Production Act funding.
* **EV Motors Demand Neodymium** : Each EV motor requires 1kg of Neodymium, and rare earth minerals are vital to the production of F-35 jets, Tomahawk cruise missiles, smartphones, jet turbines.
* **Xi Move Sparks Fury** : Trump blasted China's curbs as a 'bad moment' for security, which has fueled the U.S.'s alliance diversification.

# PREVIEW: Fed rate announcement, markets bet nearly 100% on a cut
The Federal Reserve is **[likely poised to slash interest rates](https://substack.com/redirect/a39480c7-e44d-4114-bdd4-4b039d5b0b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by a quarter-point Wednesday--the second cut in as many months--amid labor market worries and a government shutdown blacking out key jobs data. Markets bet nearly 100% on the move.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a39480c7-e44d-4114-bdd4-4b039d5b0b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Internal Dissent Brews Fiercely** : Governor Miran likely dissents for a second time, arguing for bolder half-point cut, while regional presidents urge caution on pace of easing.
* **Data Blackout Fuels Uncertainty** : The Democrat shutdown of government has delayed September payrolls data, which forces Fed to rely on state claims showing no layoff surge.
* **December Cut Nearly Certain** : Markets price near 100% odds for another reduction in December, with economists eyeing five cuts in total through April.

TuneLab Unlocks Sector Access : Biotech firms will swap data via federated learning for $1B-valued AI models, fueling collaborative precision medicine breakthroughs. Precision Meds by 2030 : AI agents, AI imaging, and biomarkers targeting genes/environments could lead to personalized cures and new molecules currently beyond human limits. Friend – I have learned that Donald Trump's Department of Justice has charged six people, including myself, with federal crimes for exercising our First Amendment rights near ICE’s Broadview processing center. **This is a political prosecution and a gross attempt at silencing dissent, a right protected under the First Amendment**. [**I'm asking for your support in this fight against a weaponized justice system with a contribution today. >>**](https://ka4il.us/l/yVOWxQHJpi5B) While we’ve seen the unhinged and unlawful tactics this administration will try to use, we have to remember that they are doing this because THEY are scared. **Here's the truth:** As I and others exercised our First Amendment rights, ICE has hit, dragged, thrown, shot with pepper balls, and teargassed hundreds of protesters, myself included. This case is yet another attempt by the Trump administration to criminalize protest and punish those who dare to speak up. Because Chicago doesn’t back down from bullies in masks who teargas our neighborhoods, this administration is resorting to weaponizing the federal legal system to scare us into silence. The Trump administration wants you to be afraid of speaking out against it and its anti-democratic power grabs. And there are plenty of reasons to be afraid right now, but we also must overcome that fear. THEY know they are wrong, they know that they are inhumane, and they know that history will not be on their side. We cannot diminish ourselves in the face of these tactics; it’s time to unite and show up for humanity, for our rights, for everyone terrorized by Trump’s lawless secret police. [**This legal fight will be extraordinarily expensive, and I need you on my team. Just $1 from each of our supporters would go a long way to ensuring we have the resources we need to defend the First Amendment.**](https://ka4il.us/l/nRAghbEpW7Pr) You’ll be hearing regular updates from me directly about the case and how we can continue to use our constitutional rights to resist authoritarianism. I’ve spent my career fighting America’s backwards slide towards fascism, and I’m not going to give up now. I hope you won’t either. In solidarity, Kat Abughazaleh Friend, it's Kat Abughazaleh, and if this isn't a sign of what's to come, I don't know what is.
As always, if you'd like to receive fewer emails, click [**here**](https://ka4il.us/l/RHgdYqPkNtjx)**,** or if you'd like to unsubscribe from all future emails, click **here**.

The detainment of Mahmoud Kahlil, the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, and the outright denial to follow a ruling made by the Supreme Court are all blatant oversteps that attack our right to free speech and due process and challenge the rule of law.
Friend, I've spent years watching Fox News and listening to their rhetoric get more and more extreme, and Donald Trump is doing exactly what they want.
**_Fascism is, and has always been, their end goal._**
Their vision is one of a militarized country where only certain people—a few dozen rich men—have a seat at the table, and dissidents like me are silenced.
Trump and Elon know that progressive movements like ours are in the way because I've made it abundantly clear that strongly worded letters, wearing matching outfits while holding up signs, and meaningless acts of symbolism **aren't my thing.**
As a member of Congress, I'm going to be unwavering in my fight for our communities.
I will not vote for authoritarian bills in the name of "compromise," I will not abandon or demonize vulnerable groups to cater to the right, and I will not change my stances for fear of retaliation.
And Friend, that's what this action on ActBlue is: retaliation. Campaigns like ours rely on small dollars from people like you to support us, and ActBlue is integral to making that work.

Janet Mills just entered the race against Susan Collins. So you’re about to get a million fundraising texts and emails from Mills and her campaign (if you haven’t already).
I’m new to this whole politics thing, but I’ve begun to learn how this works: After you donate to any establishment Democrat, Chuck Schumer and the DNC turn around and use your email address and phone number to put their thumbs on the scale – propping up their choice, even when that person is not the strongest candidate in the race.

Friend – I have learned that Donald Trump's Department of Justice has charged six people, including myself, with federal crimes for exercising our First Amendment rights near ICE’s Broadview processing center.
**This is a political prosecution and a gross attempt at silencing dissent, a right protected under the First Amendment**. [**I'm asking for your support in this fight against a weaponized justice system with a contribution today. >>**](https://goodmancampaigns.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b732c98e5acf3bb4d036dbe4c&id=a2f6cc1e30&e=ae9cef1b11)
While we’ve seen the unhinged and unlawful tactics this administration will try to use, we have to remember that they are doing this because THEY are scared.
**Here's the truth:** As I and others exercised our First Amendment rights, ICE has hit, dragged, thrown, shot with pepper balls, and teargassed hundreds of protesters, myself included.
This case is yet another attempt by the Trump administration to criminalize protest and punish those who dare to speak up. There’s simply too much on the line. Tim Walz has failed Minnesota. He’s burdened us with $10 billion in new taxes and left a $5 billion budget hole. He’s stood by while crime surged, our schools declined, and indoctrination replaced education.

My name is Kendall Qualls. I wasn’t born into privilege or power. I was raised in Harlem, New York, in the 1960s; a child of divorce and one of several siblings living in public housing. Before I reached middle school, I moved to a trailer park in Oklahoma to live with my father. Neither of my parents finished high school.
I didn’t take shortcuts. I worked full-time to put myself through college. I used student loans and paid them back in full. I served as an officer in the United States Army. I earned an MBA from the University of Michigan. Then, I spent 30 years leading teams and driving innovation in the healthcare industry — rising to become Global Vice President of an $850 million business unit.
Now, I’m running for Governor of Minnesota to make sure that the principles that lifted me - hard work, faith, family, personal responsibility, and the free enterprise system - are preserved, defended, and passed on to the next generation.
We don’t need more government. We need more opportunities.
That’s what I’m fighting for, and I need your help. [Can I count on your support today?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1qovvpvd0b83e5qvbrkseqlr4l9umt8qv1qsc88_rp22sh2s8i6eor4ctjm2pj6cdh2bs)

subject: Opponents of voting rights ready to end the Voting Rights Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
@ariberman.bsky.social: SCOTUS decision killing what’s left of Voting Rights Act could cost Dems 19 House seats, eliminate every majority-minority district in South, eviscerate 14th/15th Amendments & fulfill John Roberts 40-year crusade against country’s most important civil rights law [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102925_2&amount=25]
The impact shows how partisan this all is, Team. A complete dismantling of the Voting Rights Act -- a key civil rights law -- would only harm one political party and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we left behind sixty years ago.
During this month’s oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Step up with $25 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102925_2&amount=25]
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=102925_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=102925_2&amount=25]

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $25 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102925_2&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=102925_2&amount=20]
